reviews.author: purplenette
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 3.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Great Aesthetics, Terrible Writing: Don't Blindly Trust the 10/10 Ratings It has been a long time since I last wrote a review. However, seeing this drama flooded with perfect 10s forced me to share a more realistic perspective.Let’s be honest from the start: we can all agree that Ma Xiao Yu is incredibly attractive and a talented actor. But a hot lead does not automatically equal a 10-star masterpiece. Good: Visuals and ActingStunning Aesthetics: The sets and clothing are absolutely on point throughout the show.Solid Cast: The main actors are highly attractive and deliver genuinely good performances.Standout Supporting Role: The brother's girlfriend is an amazing character who shows true internal strength.The Bad: Toxic Dynamics and Weak WritingThe actual storyline is complete trash. It is incredibly difficult to find any redeeming qualities in the Female Lead (FL). She hires the Male Lead (ML) as her bodyguard, yet constantly does whatever she wants, fully aware that he will bear the consequences. To make matters worse, her toxic brother exploits the fact that the ML cannot say "no" to the FL, using it as an excuse to brutally torture him.The romance is equally unconvincing. The show expects the audience to believe in a deep, lifelong love between the leads, but the FL's character portrays absolutely no genuine affection. While she is supposed to be fiercely loyal to her brother, her actions in setting the ML up were simply too much to forgive.The Verdict: Dragged Out and DisappointingThe plot is heavily padded, repeatedly recycling the exact same scenarios over and over. To top it all off, the ending is awful and completely unrewarding. Enjoy the visuals and the acting, but lower your expectations for the script. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Se você está precisando de uma calmaria em meio ao caos dos dramas tóxicos... Eu sou completamente apaixonada pela intensidade que a atriz Guo Yu Xin traz para os seus personagens e gosto muito da evolução na atuação do Huang Hao Wen. Por alguma razão eu sempre acreditei que não tinha assistido esse drama e sempre postergava, mas hoje decidi dar play para perceber que eu já tinha o assistido há muito tempo atrás no Telegram kkkkkkkkkkkkMasssssss, continuei assistindo porque eu estava realmente precisando de um drama sem interferências de chá-verde, todo aquele caos que estamos sempre condicionadas a ver nos dramas verticais, mesmo que ontem eu tenha assistido um queima lenta também no novo drama do Charon & Jadie (不与青山辞 - 20/02/2026), lá achei o ritmo tão lento e não me conectei que achei tedioso, mas este, de ex-namorados se reaproximando, mais fortes, mais poderosos emocionalmente e até em questão de status, me cativa.O figurino da Guo Yu estava impecável, assim como o do Huang Hao. Gostei do respeito que eles sempre mantiveram um com o outro apesar de um término difícil, e ele determinado em reconquistá-la de uma maneira calma e dedicada. Nanshan é uma personagem que teve um passado difícil, que precisou ser forte com a perda dos pais e lutar por si mesma para ter um futuro melhor mesmo que tivesse o apoio de sua tia. Do outro lado temos o admirável e herdeiro He Bei Zheng, que tinha toda a confiança do mundo até sua namorada terminar abruptamente com ele. Gostei que ambos foram sinceros, ele com sua insegurança inicial e ela com a sua dúvida, mas sempre preocupados em sanar e não criar mal-entendidos entre si.Os últimos 10 minutos do drama foram extremamente emocionantes para mim. O ML descobrindo a verdade, confrontando uma pessoa importante, e ao fim, desejando o abraço da FL como nunca, para então ter o seu quebra-cabeça completo.Há quem ache este drama entediante, assim como eu também achei o drama do Charon, mas se você está precisando de uma calmaria em meio ao caos dos dramas abusivos, pode ser uma ótima pedida. reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Story of rebirth and hidden identities with great performances by Xue Zi Qi and Liu Yi Long I added missing dramas to Xue Zi Qi's profile months ago and when I gathered info for this drama, I saw glowing comments on Douban and Weibo. Thank gawd I have paid subscription to iQIYI. I watched it 2 weeks ago and wow, I was surprised by how much I enjoyed this drama.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - She reminded me of Mulan because of her disguise and military training. She was smart, ferocious and independent - I liked those qualities in a FL. 2. ML characterisation - I liked that he too had his own battle to overcome. He was smart and observant. I liked that he protected FL once he figured out her secret identity.3. Reborn trope - Two characters were reborn in this drama. Both of them took different path so it was fascinating to watch.4. Acting - Great performances by Xue Zi Qi and Liu Yi Long. I liked seeing Xue Zi Qi in dual identities. I also liked the chemistry between them.5. Dynamic - I enjoyed watching the dynamic between FL and ML in the various personas that they put on. She was compassionate with the Prince but cautious with mysterious masked fighter. There was push & pull between them and they did consummate their marriage but their romance was blossoming slowly.6. Action - I enjoyed the fighting sequences. They were a delight to watch and Xue Zi Qi looked extremely cool fighting the bad guys. Liu Yi Lon was great too.7. Styling - I liked the contrasting outfits for FL and ML. 8. Ending - I liked it even though it was a cliffhanger. It was cheeky. Please let there be part 2!What I disliked:1. Antagonists - FL's family were atrocious - they forced her to take on her brother's place and serve in the military. I disliked how her female elders treated her. FL's husband in the previous life was another horrible person. ML's brother was another character I disliked.Favourite sceneWhen FL & ML consummated their marriage Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 3.0 Rewatch Value 2.0 This review may contain spoilers "我就怕老婆怎么了" (So what if I'm afraid of my wife?) é melhor. Ontem eu assisti a adaptação "我就怕老婆怎么了" (So what if I'm afraid of my wife?) com o Liu Hao Qun e a Liu Man Li, lançado em janeiro de 2026, o drama possui mais de 3 horas e tem um final em aberto nas cenas pós-créditos onde aparece a frase "final da primeira temporada", o que me deixou puta da vida. Me recordei que havia outras versões dessa mesma história, e ao ver que esta tinha 4 horas e 43 minutos, pensei: "será que o gancho que deixaram realmente compensaria uma segunda temporada?". Mas me deparei com mudanças significativas na trama, acredito que o desenvolvimento se levará para o mesmo desfecho, mas veremos ao ser lançado...Foi impossível não comparar as duas versões, porque a química entre o Liu Hao Qun e a Liu Man Li era perfeita, os beijos maravilhosos e com figurinos bonitos, apesar de pecar na maquiagem. Aqui se seguiu um pouco diferente, o ator Yang Yan Guang não me convenceu no papel de um ML com 22 anos, sua maquiagem era excessiva, o deixando ainda mais velho, enquanto a atriz Zhang Zi Han tinha uma maquiagem extremamente leve por se tratar de uma FL mais velha, então isso ajudava a potencializar a maquiagem do ML, ao meu ver.Já os personagens, o ML é imaturo, tem apenas 22 anos, herdeiro e que não tem vocação para os negócios, mas achei exagerado e desnecessário toda vez ele se diminuir e o avô sempre o achar de inútil ou lixo, forçando-o a ter um filho para que esse sim assumisse os negócios da família, diferentemente da outra versão, aqui também o ML é muito mais cachorrinho da esposa, então acho que o título aqui cairia bem kkkk. Já a FL, em ambas versões, são CEOs importantes, com uma inteligência emocional grande, que acabam direcionando o ML para a maturidade, aqui a FL deixa claro que não precisa de amor logo no início, e apesar de ser carinhosa com o ML, o trata realmente como criança ou um cachorro sempre passando a mão na cabeça como recompensa.Gostei bastante da relação do ML com o avô aqui, e os antagonistas aqui são diversos e me fizeram revirar os olhos muitas vezes, pareciam que queriam apenas encher linguiça no drama porque já não tinha mais o que mostrar kkkkk. A sensação que eu fiquei ao terminar este drama é que gostei, mas não gostei. E não nego que prefiro muito mais a adaptação citada na primeira linha desta resenha, tanto pela construção do relacionamento, química ou suspense em relação ao contrato que só foi citado poucas vezes ao longo da história. Reborn, she willingly marries the powerful and ruthless, but disabled, Shang Yu Ting, intending to become a widow and then seek revenge. After marrying into the family, she secretly poisons Shang Yu Ting, but unexpectedly alleviates his insomnia. As they spend time together, she discovers that Shang Yu Ting is not as rumored and gradually suspects a grand conspiracy. synopsis: When Shi Zhi Yan woke up, she was shocked to find herself transmigrated into a cannon-fodder ex-wife — a side character in a vintage-era novel written by her petty cousin to vent her anger! In the story, she was portrayed as a brainless, flirtatious woman with a large chest, created only to highlight the heroine’s virtuous and gentle nature. In the end, the cousin’s character followed her military husband and was pampered beyond measure, while Shi Zhi Yan’s character committed every possible “sin,” was sent to labor reform, publicly denounced, tortured, and ultimately went insane — a perfect tragic contrast to the heroine! Now that she has suddenly awakened into this doomed role, with labor reform about to begin, Shi Zhi Yan decides to go all in — taking her child and escaping to find the baby’s father! (Source: Chinese = 红果短剧 app || Translation = MyDramaList) ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Mei Yan Han Qi Xie Zai Sui Jun, Da Lao Xin Huang Huang" (美艳悍妻携崽随军，大佬心慌慌), also known as "Jun Qu Xiao Xi Jing: Wo Ma Shi Da Liu Mang, Jiao Ao" (军区小戏精：我妈是大流氓，骄傲), by Er Wu Tong Tong (迩乌彤彤). reviews.author: DeepPramanick
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 9.0 Rewatch Value 8.5 THE GOLD BEHIND THE STORY If you’re a fan of Chinese short dramas, especially ones where the male lead is overpowered and attracts all the ladies, then this drama is for you!StoryThe plot follows the typical pattern of Chinese short dramas these days:A poor boy with no money → Gains an incredible secret power → A rich lady takes an interest in him → Falls in love with him → Everyone insults him → Gradually, all the women start falling for him → He becomes rich → Defeats all the villains → Still doesn’t choose a single lover because he wants them all together.(PS: Even a boy falls for him!)MusicThis is the main reason I’m watching this drama! The OST and BGM are simply outstanding. Every fight scene is amplified by the background music, making it 100 times better. Believe me, each track will slowly capture your heart. The opening and ending themes are also top-tier!ScreenplayThere are moments where the screenplay lags, but since each episode is only 10-12 minutes long, it's still bearable. To be honest, the story doesn’t go anywhere, but the short runtime creates the illusion that there’s always something more to come. It keeps you hooked, proving that screenplay controls the story.CinematographyThe camera work is fantastic! Every fight scene is captured brilliantly, and the camera movements elevate the action sequences. Even though the story has little to offer, the dynamic shots, tight screenplay, and epic BGM make it worth watching again and again. Some special camera techniques were likely used for specific scenes, making them even more engaging.LocationsThis is one of the weaker aspects. The entire drama is filmed in just 2-3 locations—his shop, a basement, a street, and someone's house. It would have been better if they had chosen more visually stunning locations for the fight and romance scenes. However, the Waner and Wei beach scene was a definite highlight.VFXSurprisingly, the VFX is far better than most Chinese short dramas these days! The ninja fight scene and the battle with Fifth Realm Mr. Gu were particularly well-executed. You can tell the budget was low, limiting the number of locations and fights, but even within these constraints, the effects were impressive. When it comes to animation, China is proving to be on par with, if not better than, Japan.DirectionDirector Lin Quin is truly a master of short-form storytelling. After watching her previous works, Forever Love and Maid’s Revenge, this is my third time experiencing her magic. She proves that you don’t need 45-minute episodes with 40 episodes to tell a compelling story—you can do it in 10-minute episodes across 30 episodes!Costumes & MakeupThis is where the drama falls short. The costumes and makeup feel out of place, as if the actors are in a stage play or a cosplay event rather than a drama. Even though it's a fantasy series, the characters could have been given a more natural, human-like appearance instead of looking like webtoon characters. The male lead wears just 2-3 shirts throughout the entire series, and the female characters also have limited outfits.ActingThe acting was top-notch, especially from Krystal Zhang—even though she was the third female lead, she completely stole the show! Every time she appeared on screen, she delivered flawlessly, with perfect dialogue timing and expressions. I’ve officially become a fan and would love to get her autograph if she ever reads this review! The other leads, Lu Yun Feng, Liu Rui Qiao, and Zhao Qi Yue, did a good job too, avoiding the overacting that’s common in such dramas.ConclusionIf you love harem dramas or Chinese short dramas where the male lead is overpowered and gets all the ladies, then this is a must-watch for you! Along with superb action, it even has 2-3 breathtaking kissing scenes.This is a hidden gem that deserves to be seen—so take it out and enjoy, harem lovers!My Rating 8/10 Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Kasia Krakowianka
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 10 Acting/Cast 10 Music 9.5 Rewatch Value 7.5 This review may contain spoilers Shockingly good and well worth the time-link I first wrote the review after watching 13 translated episodes (many thanks to SOONSETRA for delivering!!!) of this short drama (max 20 minutes long each) and here was my original impression:incredible plot with the "gotcha" villain amazing charactersawesome dialoguesfantastic acting of leads and secondaryskillful directingflawless editingbeautiful and fitting OST incl. bgm but in YT version, unfortunately I recognized music from other minidramas (incl. Li Fei's The Tale of Love and Loyalty jig) which dropped the rating half a point. tacky decoreye candy outfitsgrateful for tactful combining of serious with comedy, thought provoking with slow burn romance and consistent characterization of FL (thanks heavens).And after finishing al episodes I am sticking to the 9/10 because the story (of poisoned babies, their moms and people dear to the leads) gives depth to this slow romance and tale of friendships and blood ties. Plus we get to see a rare sadness that comes with watching what happens when you live knowing that life is ending before you even started enjoying it. I loved the romance: the actors were very well paired and delivered excellent performance. Majority of production was cohesive and even if there were goofy parts of the script/story that could have been better developed/delivered, this was almost on par with my favorite mini drama A Familiar Stranger.Who should not watch this: lovers of simplistic plot and usual tropes (I honestly did not see that much of troping here). People who cannot take ambivalence in the ending (don't worry it's good, but not "juicy kiss followed by carrying her princess style to the alcove"-very fitting for what we had seen in 24 episodes). Anybody who needs a villain all throughout the drama. Is it spectacular? No. But it has nice visuals, even though a bit tacky for my taste.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=orJVihzImyk&list=PLZHWNFciVYEN4-BtQFe_TJC2wj9TwnSPb Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: daydreamer
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 8.5 A Different Flavor of Mini Drama Magic The mini drama pantry has been serving up some surprisingly delightful treats lately.This drama offers a refreshing and intriguing plot that stands out from the sea of overly familiar tropes, and its execution is nothing short of captivating.Visually, it’s a feast. The angled shots, blurred edges, and surreal dreamlike visuals perfectly match its English title ''Half Awake in a Fleeting Life'', immersing the viewer in a hazy atmosphere where reality and memory intertwine. The flashbacks, in particular, are beautifully crafted—testament to thoughtful editing and inspired directing.The performances elevate the story even further. The entire cast shines, but I especially enjoyed the bonds the female lead shared with both the ML and the SML. The chemistry was undeniable, though my heart leaned toward the FL and SML dynamic. Perhaps I’m biased because Lin Ze Hui has always been a favorite of mine, but his character radiated such purity that he easily stole the spotlight for me.That said, the drama isn’t flawless. The background music, while featuring some familiar yet enjoyable tracks, occasionally overwhelmed the scenes with its volume and intensity. Coupled with the absence of strong subtitles, it made watching more challenging than it needed to be.Still, these drawbacks don’t eclipse the overall experience. Half Awake in a Fleeting Life is atmospheric, original, and quietly impactful. If you’re craving something different—something that feels more like a fleeting dream than a typical romance—this is a drama I’d wholeheartedly recommend. I only wish it were more widely available on streaming platforms, as tracking it down felt like a treasure hunt across various sites. But perhaps that’s fitting: sometimes the most unusual stories are the ones worth chasing. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 6.5 This review may contain spoilers Liked the emotional approach in this drama Actually i watched this last year because of Wang Nan. I quite familiar with Li Sheng Nan face since most of her old drama i watched on dramabox and i liked her acting but her script are basically damsel in distress FL. Both leads are delivers their character into a life. I know this version wont be people favorite but i personally hold this drama even it was not perfect but based from emotion depth this version wins.This version finally captures the essence: ML's deep, restrained affection over many years, finally reaching the moment he can openly and forcefully possess FL. The emotional entanglements are depicted more delicately, and the character of the SML is more compelling.SML's actions and words are also more logical in this version. He didn't relay FL's brother's message about "taking care" of the FL; it was the her brother's own decision. He didn't directly kidnap the FL; he rescued her from the kidnappers and then imprisoned her—but this still caused harm and remains unforgivable act for sure.In the end, SML admitted that SML had previously kept the FL like a caged bird, loving her and not wanting her to escape his control. Initially, SML did indeed treat FL as a substitute for his ideal woman, only slowly realizing his love after she left.Recommended if you want to see more emotional driven drama. reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers 3ª versão, melhor que Just to Possess You, mas inferior a Zhan You Qiang Wei Gostei da atuação da Li Sheng Nan e do Wang Nan, depois que começaram a namorar ficou um pouco mais natural. Há mudanças significativas nessa versão em comparação com a primeira, Zhan You Qiang Wei (2025), e poucas algumas mudanças deste para a segunda versão (além da redução de tempo) de Just to Possess You (2025). A primeira versão, por mais que seja extensa de quase 3 horas, ainda é a melhor. Seja pela naturalidade do casal, ou pela maneira que os personagens foram construídos e se desenvolvendo ao longo do drama.Não vou me estender muito nesta resenha, minha crítica maior foi em Just to Possess You sobre todas as mudanças que não gostei e, infelizmente aqui foram seguidas também. Mas sem dúvidas este, no quesito química de CP, é melhor que a segunda versão. Pelos comentários abaixo apontaram uma possível 4ª adaptação, mas ainda não encontrei para assistir, espero que logo entre no MDL se realmente existir para finalizar este enredo. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Love story between emperor and concubine with great chemistry & outfits I am Zhang Chu Xuan fangirl so I was excited to see this drama co-starring Wang Jia Mao. Gosh the last time I watched his drama was months ago. I enjoyed this drama a lot.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - I loved her cunning tricks to win over ML's heart & body. Her smartness fit the ideals of women in historical era (sometimes writers overindulged by making revengeful FL too smart).2. ML characterisation - I also liked his scheming and protectiveness. He doted on FL and tried his best to keep it hidden from other people to avoid accusation of unfairness. I liked that he was a one-woman man despite his circumstances. I loved Wang Jia Mao in this role - he was dreamy.3. Romance - Intense attraction & lust which turned out to be genuine love. I liked that they were affectionate with each other.4. Supporting characters - ML's advisor being his confidante - I loved it! I also liked FL's servant.5. Styling - I loved the outfits for FL & ML especially their outfits at the start. The mesh top was so sexy on WJM and ZCX looked gorgeous in shoulder-baring dresses.6. Tone - I enjoyed the comedic moments that appear a lot in the first & second acts. Nice transition to more dramatic third act.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - FL's sister was despicable. Glad FL kept her at a distance post-rebirth. Since FL was concubine, she had many rivals (Empress Dowager, Concubine Wen) who were horrible.Favourite sceneWhen FL disguised herself to see ML. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: TTR - The Truth Review
reviews.review_text: Overall 1.0 Story 1.0 Acting/Cast 1.0 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Another diabolical piece of crap Just total garbage. The people that produce this content sick in the head because honestly when you advertise something as a romance but continue to brutally torture abuse and humiliate the heroes from beginning to end does that go into the realms of a deep seated demented state of mind? Who finds this kind of stuff entertaining? I’m really curious because there was a bit in the middle where the MLNFL had a bit of respite where they were being lovey-dovey but then five seconds later they decided to arrest him on some trumped up murder charge and we had to witness him being brutally tortured in prison for about three episodes. This show did not want to give us a break. It kept trying to give us like romantic moments but immediately was persistent in ensuring the villains were always having the upper hand until about 10 seconds from the end of episode 23.. I find it utterly disgusting and ridiculous that this content is allowed to be produced. I’m not believing any of the hype about censorship or watching a hero perseverance and resilience because they seem to lap it up when it’s time to torture the heroes, but we can’t ever see the villain taking too big of a loss.. it’s all rather disturbing Read More Was this review helpful to you?

synopsis: Sang Ning, the legitimate eldest daughter of a prestigious family, had been raised since childhood to become the household’s future matriarch. Upon opening her eyes, however, she finds herself in a completely unfamiliar era—where she is now the true daughter of a wealthy family who was mistakenly left in the countryside. Fortunately, she remains the legitimate eldest daughter. Her fake younger sister flaunts her supposed superiority, claiming to be a graduate of an elite school and highly accomplished? Yet she knows nothing of music, chess, calligraphy, or painting—how dare she boast? Her family speaks of guilt but in truth shows favoritism toward the fake sister? No matter—family intrigue has always been Sang Ning’s strongest skill. Some accuse her of lacking proper manners? Within a month of her return, the entire Nan household is horrified to realize that the supposedly rustic eldest daughter is actually more traditional and strict than the patriarch himself. reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers Well-written & acted FL-focused drama about love, career and family I love the first part of this drama. There was whimsical and magical vibe to it but the ending was abrupt. Then a few weeks ago, I was ecstatic upon finding out that there was second part to this story. I watched within a few days of release and was spellbound. Loved it immensely.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - She was a woman who knew what she wanted for her career and went full steam for it. The career vs love conflict that she faced was relatable and I liked that she struggled and learned that love could be a priority in her life too.2. ML characterisation - He was loving, patience and the most chilled nepo baby hehehe he's more concerned about FL's career than his and I liked that he didn't feel emasculated by her high ambitions. 3. Romance - Affectionate & healthy with physical touch being their love language. The breakup was understandable but it was great that they worked things out. I really liked the proposal.4. Acting - Great performances by the cast. Li Ke Yi & Lu Dan Dong had wonderful chemistry & rapport. 5. Supporting characters - I liked FL's bestie, ML's bestie and ML's grandma. Even FL's sister was ok after she learnt her lesson.6. Styling - Loved the outfits for both FL & ML.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - FL's family members were horrible especially the grandfather and father. synopsis: A metaphysics expert undergoes a tribulation and enters the mortal body of Jiang Chu Wan, gaining the ability to see the countdown of people’s remaining lifespan above their heads. In her spare time, she takes on the identity of a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner, treating people who suffer from various unusual illnesses. Fu Yan An is one such patient. Three years earlier, Jiang Chu Wan happened to save Fu Yan An when his life was in danger, only to discover that he had been afflicted with a rare and difficult love-related curse. From that point on, Fu Yan An develops feelings for her. When they meet again, Fu Yan An immediately recognizes Jiang Chu Wan as the person from three years ago and can no longer suppress his emotions. Knowing that his time is limited, he decides to act for himself once, proposes marriage, and holds on to a small hope that they may continue to love each other. reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Light but sexy drama about faceblind ML & his secretary I was browsing new releases and randomly picked this drama. I hadn't seen the work of Nie Zi Xuan nor Li Nuo so I was curious. Wow, what an opening scene! I decided to watch the drama in full and yes, I enjoyed this drama a lot.What I liked:1. Intimacy - The first minute was damn hot. Their intimate scenes were hot because I could sense desire mixed in with slight playfulness.2. Nie Zi Xuan - Well, hello gorgeous. He was Adonis - a manly man with sharp jawline. I loved his voice.3. Supporting characters - I liked FL's friend.4. Main characters - Both were likeable. I liked that ML knew about the deception early on and just played along with FL's ruse.5. Tone - This drama was lighthearted. 6. Acting - Both Li Nuo and Nie Zi Xuan gave good performances individually and as a pair. They had believable chemistry and I assumed good rapport because the intimate scenes were damn hot.What I disliked:1. Fake identity - FL's ruse went on too long. I wish she had come clean after the second time they were intimate.2. Romance - They had sex and they worked together. However I wish there was more time spent on their romantic relationship. reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 3.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers innocent yet alluring uncle loli drama I watched this last year because of Gong Fang Ni and i quite picky about uncle and little girl love story drama this one was not greasy at all. This one has the most obvious age gap and a lot of ambiguous and tumultuous relationships. Both the lead delivers their acting well and Chen Zhen Yang didn't use body double for abs (which is quite rare for him) and the kisses still look okay from Chen Zhen Yang level but the chemistry still not on maximum level.In the first half, FL is a bit insecure because she has a crush on the male lead, so there are often misunderstandings and quite a few crying scenes. ML is always flirting with FL, and after the seal is broken, he frantically helps her find inspiration (see episode 43 for details). In one episode, FL's abs drawing is publicly displayed by ML. We comic book lovers are really shocked, it feels like fujoshi's fetish has been caught red-handed.Their relationship became even sweeter, with frequent intimate scenes, and the intimate scenes were filmed quite beautifully but they need to adjust the background to make the atmosphere more intense. But at the same time the plot was become flat after they got together. To add the conflict they make traditional SFL to make another misunderstand between the lead and the couple solved it together.If you want to watch innocent yet alluring uncle and little girl drama, you could watch this. reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers “Your shadow is dirty let me wipe it for you” kkkkkkkkk Anteontem descobri que era uma sequência de adaptações, ao me deparar com o pôster da primeira adaptação Secret Love (2024) e até comentei naquela resenha deste drama que havia assistido assim que lançou no final de 2025.Eu gosto de ambos os atores, Gong Fang Ni (Kitty) e o Chen Zheng Yang, seus figurinos eram ok, mas nem sempre as interações mais íntimas eram boas, apesar de até que frequentes.Eu gargalhei alto com a frase: “Your shadow is dirty let me wipe it for you” kkkkkkkkkO começo do drama foi ótimo, bem engraçado e leve, mas depois esfriou...O ML flertava bastante com a FL assim que descobriu a verdade, mas houveram muitos mal-entendidos, além da primeira adaptação, e não sei explicar ao certo onde foi que senti uma queda brusca no ritmo, se tornou mais um passatempo a ser assistido do que assimilado, entende? kkkkAchei que algumas situações que a FL acabou envolvida sofrendo o bullying desnecessárias, porque o drama tinha tudo para ser algo leve sobre um longo período de amor oculto sabe kkkkkAcho que a cena mais bonita é a que é similar ao pôster que a xxmai publicou, (não a que está como oficial). reviews.author: addicted_2_dramas
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.5 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 3.5 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers Finally Something New! I'm currently sitting at my screen smiling like an idiot. Yes, this was "technically" a revenge drama but it was more than that. It was a story about a girl who had her first (and purest) love betrayed and broken, only to be followed by the death of her mother whom she had left on bad terms because of that first love. I like that they story doesnt dwell on it but focus on her healing journey, from pioneering a life saving cardiac device to healing and opening her heart again. I'm glad the grandmother didnt put up with her son's shenanigans and chose to wait for her more ethical grandson to come into his own. The FL spent a decade maintaining and building their company and the father-son duo did not hesitate to kill her mother. To the FL and 2FL: ladies you dodged a nuclear warhead. To Cdrama Writers: this was great. don't. touch. it. we dont need 20 remakes of the same thing. Find new material. If you really can't find anything else on the entire internet *I* will write something for you. I should comment that I generally write children's books and fanfiction but I would make an exception. reviews.review_text: Overall 9.5 Story 9.5 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 9.5 Rewatch Value 9.5 Moonset in the Embrace of the Boat (2025) is a very good romance miniseries with Min Jie (as Lin Zhou Huai) and Zhu Xiao Xue (as Lou Yue) in the leading couples roles. The leading couple had great rapport and a tender impassionate chemistry; the male lead's steadfast love and protection led to a successful partnership and a devoted loving relationship. The cast did a good job bringing their characters to life and, although the drama could've used a few more episodes, the cast did very well with their allotted time. Overall, this drama is entertaining; enjoy it!In the meantime, you can watch the drama on YouTube:"He abandoned me for his benefit of wealthy family, but he went crazy after I married his CEO brother" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=364bL3Z4FKk) or "He refused to marry her but demanded she be his mistress. She married his brother—he went crazy" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tW_aBH04ilg) Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Eu gosto muito dos personagens do Min Jie e adoro a atriz Zhu Xiao Xue, acho que os dois combinaram muito bem atuando juntos, com uma química boa e naturalidade nas aproximações. Os figurinos eram bonitos, gostei das roupas da FL, e as maquiagens de ambos não eram carregadas, deixando um pouco mais natural.A história, apesar de não ser inovadora, é interessante, eu gostei de que seja um drama curto, de apenas 46 episódios, dando uma hora e 37 minutos por aí, porque, quando bem desenvolvido, o ritmo é bom, não se torna aquela coisa arrastada ou extremamente complexa, mas eu queria ter visto mais do casal e não só sobre a rede de artimanhas da família Xie, mas é aquilo né, a gente sempre pode pontuar coisas que poderiam melhorar, mas deixo claro que isso não significa que o drama é ruim. synopsis: Song Xi gets drunk, mistakes someone for someone else, and wakes up to discover she has registered her marriage with a handsome stranger—Jing Zhuo. Meanwhile, her best friend Zhang He Ning relentlessly complains that her own older brother is fierce, rigid, and impossible to deal with. Song Xi nods along, secretly relieved she stayed far away from that “big devil.” But then she discovers her flash-marriage husband Jing Zhuo not only calls her “baby” at night but spoils her in every possible way—so sweet it hurts. When the truth finally comes out, Song Xi realizes the “living hell-king” she tried so hard to avoid… is the same man who has been pampering her like a treasure this whole time. A marriage born from a drunken misunderstanding turns into a nonstop cascade of adorable contrasts and overwhelming sweetness. (Source: Chinese = 红果短剧 app || Translation = MyDramaList) ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Gui Mi Shuo Da Ge Xiong, Ke Ta Ye Li Han Wo Bao Bao" (闺蜜说大哥凶，可他夜里喊我宝宝), also known as "Shang Shang Xi" (上上禧), by Liu Qi (鎏旗). synopsis: Su Mo, a book fan who knows martial arts, accidentally traveled into the much-criticized novel "The President's Wife is Wronged". Knowing the direction of the story, she planned to sign the contract, take the money and run away, but was overheard by the male protagonist Gu Yanzhou and his family. Knowing the tragic future, the male protagonist did not divorce for the time being, and Su Mo retaliated by selling the household items, which attracted admirers and family members to pursue, but the eavesdropping continued. When the whole family knew their own tragic endings, their attitudes suddenly changed, and they pulled Su Mo to deal with the crisis. Everyone worked together to eliminate the scumbag, fight the scheming woman, expose the illegitimate child's conspiracy, and get rid of the original owner's family, working together to rewrite their destiny and live a happy life. Actually this version was not too bad Zhao Caizi still got her comedic side even the ML family still got their banter while Wen Yu was too stiff for comedy drama even his conversation is make me boring felt like AI reading script. The chemistry between Zhao Caizi and Wen Yu are non-existent even as dynamic duo. Supporting cast are helping for making this comedy drama are not too tacky and helps this drama avoid the disaster.The plot are usual happened on mind reading drama. So I won't explain too much. He protected FL from being bullied by her family. I liked that he apologised after realising he made false assumption about FL.4. Supporting characters - I liked ML's sister.5. Styling - I liked ML's outfits.What I disliked:1. Romance - Underdeveloped. Both liked each other but too scared to make a move. It was frustrating. I wanted more kisses & physical touches!!!2. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.5 This review may contain spoilers First part was great but when FL and ML together the plot went downhill I watched this last year and it was quite memorable Song Yuan Ye because of Yao Guan Yu acting but still didn't become my favorite drama. Sun Lulu acting was quite decent compare to another version.The beginning is quite interesting, with the plot revolving around the female lead forcibly taking her childhood friend's fiancée, but in reality, FL has amnesia and has forgotten ML However, the plot falls apart later on, feeling anticlimactic and leaving many plot holes unresolved. Sun Lulu have a slight on-screen chemistry with Yao Guanyu. It would have been better if there hadn't been the kidnapping scene at the end it's really distracting the dramas.Still decent watch though. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: GLbeach
reviews.review_text: Overall 10 Story 10 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 10 Rewatch Value 10 Great short story I’ve watched the first 30 episodes of Hidden Treasures, and I’m thoroughly enjoying the journey so far. This drama has a quietly compelling presence, drawing you in with its strong acting, thoughtful pacing, and well-crafted world. While I still don’t know exactly where the story is headed—which is part of the intrigue—the characters are rich enough to keep me fully invested.One of the standout aspects is the acting. Every character feels grounded and believable, from the leads to the supporting cast. The emotional nuance, especially in quieter scenes, adds a depth that makes each episode satisfying to watch.The storyline has been steadily unfolding, dropping small clues and building tension without rushing. It’s not fast-paced, but that works in its favor—it allows time to explore the characters’ motivations and relationships. I’m genuinely curious to see how the plot evolves and where the hidden layers will take us.What I especially appreciate is the portrayal of the male lead. Instead of aggressively pursuing the female lead, he takes a more patient and respectful approach. There’s something refreshing about a slow-burn romance where emotional trust is prioritized over flashy gestures. It creates a feeling of authenticity and maturity that makes their dynamic all the more engaging. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Tat
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 Watched on iqiyi under the title "Pursue the Introvert Instead." It was a really good second chance drama (where the character dies and goes back in time for a chance to relive their life). I loved that reversed some of the more annoying and common tropes like miscommunication/misunderstanding being the major source of conflict. It might end to fluffy and unrealisticly happily for some hardcore drama fans, but after watching so many shows where things go wrong, this was refreshingly sweet. Also, the random Zelda Ocarina of Time music in episodes 23 and 71 had more rolling on the floor laughing! Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Draggy but good version of reformed gangster girl with doctor husband & son I watched this drama at the recommendation of a reddit member. This is the second time I watched FL Liu Can's drama but ML Li Ye Chen was unfamiliar to me. Overall the drama was a good watch but some parts were draggy.There is the first version of this 'reformed gangster girl with doctor husband and son' plot. What I liked:1. FL characterisation - I liked that she turned her life around. She was mean in her previous life but had learnt her lessons and worked very hard to earn a living so her family of three wouldn't suffer from poverty.2. Redemption - She was sincere about wanting to change and those moments made me teary eyed. 3. Supporting characters - Their son was so cute. ML's parents were suspicious of FL because ML was secretive about his marriage but they accepted FL after getting to know her.4. Styling - Loved FL's outfits. The wide leg trousers & black jacket. Thr purple too & purple skirt combo.What I disliked:1. Duration - Too long. I got bored in the second half that I increased speed to 2.0x.2. Romance - Sadly underdeveloped. With that length of drama, I thought we could get more romantic scenes but nope. Director & writer focused on her career instead. I also didn't feel much love & affection coming from ML.3. Antagonists - FL's family were money hungry but they got their retribution at the end.Favourite sceneWhen FL tried out clothes at a store. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 6.5 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 3.0 This review may contain spoilers The rebirth of ML and his pursuit of revenge. Wish there were more romance I watched this drama at the recommendation of reddit friend. I had watched Xue Zi Qi as SFL but this is my first drama with her as FL. Overall I liked this drama though I wish for more.What I liked:1. Role reversal - I liked that ML was more nurturing, househusband type while FL was influential CEO. 2. Romance - Clearly FL was more into ML in the relationship. Overall sweet romance. XZQ is a good kisser though I wish there were more kissing scenes. 3. Reborn - This is my first ML reborn drama and I enjoyed it. It's interesting to see ML seeking revenge for bad treatment he got in past life.4. Styling - I loved XZQ's hairstyle - the shorter above shoulder cut suits her! I also loved her dresses & hats.What I disliked:1 . Antagonists - Typical antagonist - jealous family members. I doubled the speed when their scenes took place because they were nothing new.2. Revenge - I found the arc draggy because a lot of yapping. Wish there was more romance scenes.Favourite sceneThe morning after Read More Was this review helpful to you?

synopsis: It tells the story of the stand-in bride Ye Chu He, who pretends to be grief-stricken at her late husband’s funeral while secretly feeling relieved to be freed, only to be seen by her wheelchair-bound elder brother-in-law, Shen Yan Ci. At first, the two are wary of each other, each assuming the other to be a rival in the fight for the family inheritance. As the story unfolds, Ye Chu He struggles under pressure from her mother-in-law Zhou Rui Hua and other relatives, unaware that Shen Yan Ci has already helped her in secret on multiple occasions. reviews.author: Bali
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 10 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 9.0 This review may contain spoilers Ta Pian Yao (2025), aka Love, Lies, and Second Chances (2025), is a nice second chance at love miniseries with ML: Yang Han/Alf Yang (as Pei He Xiao) and FL: Yang Luo Qian (as Lin Shen Shen) in the leading couple's role. Most of the cast did a good job bringing their characters to life, and the leading couple, even when their kisses could've been better, had great rapport and intense sensual chemistry. The story from two years from the time that the drama starts frames the attitudes, fears, and longing of the present time as it unravels, thread by thread, to give the audience a wider view into the main and some influential supporting characters, and little by little, each piece of the puzzle falls into place. Overall, this drama is quite entertaining; enjoy it!FULL Version: (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TYoLMKNNB10) or (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GktaOL5N0_0)PS: The down side to the drama is that the translation was done with English names that are quite annoying. reviews.author: Li Mu Yan
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 9.5 Rewatch Value 7.5 Delightfully Frustrating—And Still Totally Worth Watching This drama? Pretty good, not gonna lie. The cast? Solid. Some of the characters made me laugh so hard I had to pause just to breathe. It had charm, it had comedy, it had... Gou Ling Feng.Now listen, I know Gou Ling Feng is kind. I know he’s loyal. A walking golden retriever in a historical costume. But I swear his brain must’ve been on vacation for 90% of the drama. Clues were literally raining from the sky, people were dropping hints like it was clearance sale season, and this man still said, “Hmm… I think I’ll go with my gut feeling” — which, spoiler alert, was always wrong.By the time he finally started putting two and two together, I had already emotionally adopted the supporting characters. They were the real MVPs. Gou Ling Feng? Love him, but watching him solve things was like watching a turtle do calculus.Still, I’d absolutely recommend this drama—it’s fun, it’s entertaining, and despite a few head-scratching moments, it’s totally worth the watch! reviews.author: SpillTheDramaTea
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 7.5 Rewatch Value 9.5 Hidden Master: Comedy Meets the Misjudged Hero of Wuxia 🔹 Addictiveness & Bingable: Yes (Special Edition cut) 🔹 Rated for binge factor and ensemble chemistry. This series isn’t about big-budget visuals or deep story arcs. 🔹 What if learning a “demonic” skill made you the hero and the punchline at the same time?📕 Overview 🔹 30 episodes, comedy and wuxia (costume) 🔹 Avg runtime (Special Edition): about 15–16 minutes 🔹 Avg runtime (Full episodes): about 32–35 minutes 🔹 Runtime note: Special Edition cuts are shorter per episode; the full-length versions elsewhere run nearly double. 🔹 Xu Zhisheng gives heart to Gou Lingfeng, an unfortunate yet kind wanderer who accidentally masters a feared technique and faces premature judgment 🔹 Fan Jingyi plays Ma Yingdan, a loyal ally with a sharp wit who helps Gou scramble through the chaos. 🔹 Gou’s journey begins with suspicion and leads into cases that question what “good” or “evil” in martial arts really means. 🔹 At the time of this review, all 30 episodes have aired. 🔹 This short-form wuxia comedy stands out for its slapstick humor and playful special effects. It’s fast, funny, and never too serious.🌸 How It Felt Watching 🔹 Every episode felt snappy and inviting, easy to hit “play next” without hesitation. 🔹 Tone: playful, irreverent, just a little wild 🔹 Themes: acceptance, identity, friendship, and the blurred line between reputation and character. 🔹 It reminded me of "Word of Honor" (2021), but "Hidden Master" adds a lighter, slapstick twist to the wuxia themes of the ‘righteous versus demonic’ gray areas and the traveling duo dynamic.✨ Cast & Acting 🔹 Xu Zhisheng brings a natural comic timing that makes Gou’s bad luck fun to root for. 🔹 Fan Jingyi balances mishaps together; their banter has crowd appeal. 🔹 Zhuge Heng and the others maintain a lively pace, serving as playful contrasts to each misunderstanding or case revelation.🎞️ Production Style 🔹 The director's playful style and the team's costume and color choices ensure every scene delivers a joke or sets a mood. 🔹 Visual effects are subtle yet clever, adding humor during fights and misunderstandings that other dramas might treat seriously. 🔹 The color palette becomes brighter in street scenes and more muted in halls or tribunals, so you always anticipate what’s coming. 🔹 Pacing sticks with tight arcs and swift transitions that suit the short-form cut.☕ Tea Notes 🔹 What worked: breezy pacing, strong chemistry, comic VFX that make gags land, catchy OST cues, lots of quotable moments 🔹 What didn’t: repetitive jokes in a few arcs, some flat punchlines, and a mid-season dip in momentum☕ SpillTheDramaTea’s Rating: 8.5/10 🌿 Tea-Scale: “Full-bodied, punchy, and best watched with friends.”✏️ As SpillTheDramaTea, can a misunderstood hero win the world, or is being an outsider the real adventure? reviews.author: vivi
reviews.review_text: Overall 10 Story 9.5 Acting/Cast 10 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 Just watch it If you're a fan of the cdrama bromance genre that does everything short of being censored, and you love the following typical danmei tropes, then this is for you. It's got the innocent younger MC turned into powerful obsessive person after a timeskip, wife-chasing crematorium (or whatever the english translation for that term is) after a misunderstanding, older ML that used to be a mentor, etc. The acting is pretty good, and overall it definitely gives higher quality than what you might expect from a short drama. This is absolutely my favorite short-form "bromance" cdrama that i've seen, and it's the best out there if you're also looking for this specific relationship dynamic. reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 Title: Jie Geng Sheng Kai Shi (2025) aka Balloon Flower (2025) is a very good rebirth romance drama with Li Quan Cheng (as Fu Zheng) and Zhai Yiying (as Wen Li). This miniseries is well done and the cast did a good job bringing their characters to life. The leading couple has very good and natural chemistry and Zhai Yi Ting (as Wen Li) did a great job being delightfully cunning as she tries to seduce Li Quan Cheng (as Fu Zheng). Overall, this drama is quite entertaining, enjoy it!This drama can be found on YouTube under the caption: “On His Heart: Uncle Melts Too Easily | Li Quencheng & Zhai Yiying” or “Zhai Yiying & Li Quancheng/ My uncle, who has nothing to do with me, took care of me for three years” or “On His Heart: Uncle Melts Too Easily | Li Quencheng & Zhai Yiying” Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Zhai Yiying first enjoyable drama.. Actually i watch this last year i never think Zhai Yiying has acting skill until i see this. Personally i liked Wang Yiran-Shi Tong drama so i give my self try to see another version.I consider this Zhai Yiying's representative drama. Her makeup and styling in this drama suit her better than in any other drama I've seen. She perfectly embodies the charming cuteness of a young girl, and her crying scenes are decent. For me she is better Wen Li on this version than Shi Tong.This is my first time watching Li Quan Cheng's drama, but his sexual tension is amazing. I realized this is also his peak in terms of styling. However, their two kissing scenes are like two clam spirits, terrible. The flaws don't detract from the overall quality. He needs to catch up Wang Yiran acting skill.One thing I don't understand is that ML is also reborn, so why did he keep rejecting the FL in the beginning? He never understand love in either of his two lives. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 4.5 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers O que começou meio estranho terminou ainda mais... Passei raiva com essa versão kkkkkk 3 horas e 33 minutos! A FL, como sempre renasce e corre atrás do "tio", mas o ML é um frouxo, faz de tudo para afastar a FL e, como em todas as outras versões, ele foge para o exterior, mas quando a FL o procura depois dos exames, nesta versão ele até finge estar noivo da ex-namorada do amigo (aqui é a 2FL que diz a famosa frase: se eles conseguirem, me sentarei na mesa principal do banquete) para afastar a FL. Enquanto ela até tenta ajudar a FL e o ML a expressarem seus sentimentos ao empurrá-la na piscina e acaba gerando todo um mal-entendido entre os presentes que fofocam dizendo que a FL jogou a 2FL e ele a afasta dizendo que a única que pode ser sua noiva é a outra. Me deu vontade de dar um tapa na cara dele kkkkkApesar da cena do aeroporto e o possível acidente de avião da FL parecer que seria crucial pra que o ML acordasse, não! O infeliz volta pra China, arruma mais encontros as cegas. E depois, meio do nada, ele já está mais próximo dela e sorrindo mais pra ela. Até que ela sofre um acidente de carro (igual a vida passada, mas sem entrar em coma) e voilá, ele diz que aceita que ela seja sua namorada se ela acordar kkkkkkkEu estava feliz em ela ter dito sobre a vida passada como se fosse o sonho até que....MEU DEUS, o que foi esse final????? Ele também renasceu e ainda fez tudo que fez para a FL se afastar dele????????????Ele achava o que????? Se na outra vida, que ele estava longe, ela passou tudo que passou, por que não correspondeu então os sentimentos dela assim que ela concluiu os exames???????Sério, não faz sentido.... But i need to say the plot was unbearable to watch. The father kidnaps and drugged his sister, and the father's character was one of baddest character in all version i watch. Luckily this drama only has 59 episodes, the fewest of all the versions. There are very few sweet kisses, the pacing is fast, and the ending isn't as good as the others, too abrupt. Its only advantage is the high visual appeal of the four main characters. Wang Nian Jiang Cheng is good-looking, but he doesn't feel like older brother at all, lacking maturity and his lack of chemistry with He Tian Tian was so obvious too watch. Fortunately, his younger brother, Xiang Shuai, is more youthful and his chemistry with Xue Ziqi were more satisfying to watch it feels watching Omega Man with Alpha Woman. He Tian Tian character was so annoying, i couldn't stand her childishness and i just stay for Older Sister and Younger Brother story. Recommended only if you are hardcore fans of the actor. reviews.author: BurntBaguettes
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 7.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 9.0 This review may contain spoilers I am single-handedly keeping these crappy Chinese short-drama companies in business, lmao Okay, I am writing reviews for shows, and this one is next on my list. I finished this a while ago. It took me starting this twice and finally watching it with my friend, but it's done, and I actually enjoyed it quite a bit. I would give it an 8 out of 10, and then I am going to say what I liked, what I didn't, and then be done with this show.Starting strong with what I liked, I think the plot, while very basic, was handled very well, mainly because the character writing was absolute HEAT. I feel like I don't say that a lot, especially for short dramas, but for what this was, the character writing was so fun. So basically, we have two sisters. Because they have no brothers, the oldest sister runs the company, and she is obviously under a lot of pressure. Then the two of them are set to marry two brothers, with the two oldest getting together and the two youngest getting together. And just like most plots (besides the two sisters getting married to run away from the marriage, that was sus), on a rainy night the sisters swap, with the older sister going with the younger brother and the younger sister going with the older brother. So we see where this is going, right? WRONG. Unlike many shows where we make both of our female leads incompetent, THE OLDER SISTER IS A DOMMY MOMMY, LIKE HELLO? THE YOUNGER BROTHER LITERALLY IS GETTING PEGGED (I don't have proof but trust) AND IT WAS JUST HEAT. Like, I think I loved it so much because of this: having a basic trope but breaking away from it in the best way possible, but yeah.I especially liked the whole thing with the sisters' family, hating on her because she is a woman and then her proving them wrong, like I love that. I also love the dynamic between the younger sister and older brother; that was adorable, but it was truly just a great time all around, and whoever crafted up this shit you deserved to get your ass ate back and front because holy moly. I ALSO love me an unintentional commentary on misogyny and have roles flipped; love that so much.The main things I didn't like were the sisters getting married, and the ending kind of fell off. Okay, so I mentioned this earlier. It's very suspicious. The two sisters, to get out of the marriages with the brothers, they get married at the start, and they gotta brush that off, and then it becomes a whole thing later, or an incest scandal, rightfully so because that was really weird. I did not like that. We didn't even need to do that because we ended up going to sleep with them anyway, so that just felt pointless and fetish-y, which I did not like. The second thing I didn't like was that the ending kind of fell off. I think it started off really strong, and then because it was damn near 60 episodes, it was hard to fill out all that, especially with the plot and the writing, so it kind of fell off. But other than that, I really enjoyed this.I would recommend this for anybody bored out of their mind or who wants to watch a new short drama with their friends. Also, I would pay for this shit for real, for real. Okay bye! Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 10 The ML acting was so freakin good! Plot was cute! This was my first time seeing this male actor and all I can say was that he definitely carried this drama. This is my first time writing a vertical cdrama review and THAT is saying something. The fl, I’m more familiar with her and I do think her acting was decent. The storyline is very cute and straightforward, don’t you just love when a man likes you so much that he’s willing to chase you everyday. The ML was funny, a little childish but in a cute way, and protective! Also, VERY flirty to the FL and FL only! I paused so many times because the way the ML acts around the FL kept making me giggle lol he has the best personality. A total simp— more specifically, a LOYAL simp. He was charming and very likeable. Kudos to the actor, he can definitely make it big if he keeps up with the good work. OKAY OKAY now to review the ACTUAL story. All the characters were fine, the side characters acting are all pretty decent, including the male friends of the ML. I love brother’s friend plot, so I didn’t really find the plot that new or odd. For me, the age gap is fine. I don’t necessarily find it weird but at the same time, I wish he didn’t like her at first sight when she’s like a high school student lol. Don’t worry tho, he only started to pursue her after she entered college. They didn’t really focus much on the family, mostly just to them which i personally enjoy hehe. The step brother, well, is a bit questionable but also I don’t really get what’s going on in his head most of the time. Overall, it was a good watch and will definitely rewatch it again! reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Wholesome romance with no green tea This drama was hotly requested in a subreddit. Luckily the drama is available on iQIYI app - so I watched it there to make my subscription worthwhile. It was a good watch.What I liked:1. Acting - Ma Qian Qian was excellent in her role as a down-to-earth struggling everyday people. I emphathise with her character. This is my second Ji Jun Liang drama and gosh both times he played a cocky guy who got humbled by a circumstance. Good actong chemistry between the two.2. FL characterisation - She was earnest, too nice and not worldly and I liked that about her. I understood why she helped her fiancé with money matters - she wanted to have her own home & family and that moved me.3. Supporting characters - I loved FL's boss Sister Lin & her husband, ML's cousin Lu Xu & ML's bodyguard. They all have good intentions for the couple.4. Styling - OMG 😍 Ji Jun Liang in biker outfit! He was 🔥! 5. Romance - I'm 50-50 about their romance because ML wasn't truthful until after the marriage certificate was obtained. However their dates were cute even though orchestrated. There were some kisses wish there were steamy ones but I think director wanted a wholesome drama.6. Antagonist arc - Yes for once we don't have green tea in this drama. The main antagonist is ML's jealous uncle and boy there was a good arc for him. I really liked the scene when he was honest with his family.What I disliked:1. ML characterisation - I disliked the scheming. I could see he was slowly falling for her but wish he had come clean before they got marriage certificate.2. ML's grandmother - Wow what an insecure woman. I can't believe she was consumed by wealth.Favourite sceneThe first time ML & FL met. What a meet cute! Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers Hilarious transmigration, systems drama with great romance arc I came across this drama on youtube a few days ago and after reading positive comments, I saved it into my playlist. Yesterday I was in the mood for something warm with good kisses so I watched this drama. I was not disappointed.What I liked:1. Plot - This drama uses transmigration and systems trope and I enjoyed it. I liked that FL was given two options i) return to original world, ii) remain in the same world, because many systems drama that I watched do not offer them to main characters making me feel like they had no choice but to stay and make the best of the current world.2. FL characterisation - She gave mixed signals to characters closed to her but I found her charming & likeable. 3. Acting - Guo Xin Rui was awesome in this role with great comedic performance. She made FL self-deprecatingly funny. This is my second Ma Shuo Qi drama and I liked his performance as well. GXR & MSQ had great chemistry here. 4. Romance - Slow burn romance with FL trying to follow the plot but couldn't and ML trying to resist FL's charm but failed to do so. Even when there were at odds with each other, I could sense the sexual pull between them. Their kisses were good. There was even a cosplay scene which was adorable & funny. 5. Supporting characters - I really liked FL's sister - she was sensible, strong & had a no-nonsense mindset. She was the opposite of scatterbrained FL. I also liked ML's friend who ovserved ML's behaviour and kept teasing him for being a love brain.6. Comedy - So many hilarious scenes. My favourite is when ML asked FL to scratch his "itchy" back.7. Kidnapping scene - Damn, what a refreshing take! What I disliked:1. Antagonist - I disliked ML's childhood friend who overstepped the boundaries because of her "love" for ML. She was disrespectful towards him. I also disliked ML's adopted sister who was possessive of ML because of her love for him. It was wonderful to hear FL telling her the reality of the situation betwen adopted sister and ML. I also disliked ML's mother for favouring childhood friend over her own daughter-in-law. They already married so move on!Favourite sceneWhen ML asked FL to scratch his "itchy" back Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: addicted_2_dramas
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 3.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Actors didnt have chemistry I felt like their chemistry was kinda stunted which is odd coming from Liang Siwei. The guy could star in a love sorry with drywall and somehow have chemistry with it. Meng Na is hit or miss depending on who she co-stars with. However, they were both a miss here. Perhaps it's time to pair them with other talented actors and actresses? (drywall excluded)Content-wise I mean they tried... and I know everyone in the entertainment industry is struggling with AI taking so many jobs. I know the point of vertical dramas are the quantity but I think this is a good example of two great leads, a good script, and a good director but not all working great together. Hope to see everyone again in the future doing what they do best with the right people. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 4.0 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 2.0 This review may contain spoilers 1ª e pior versão... Nossa, eu assisti a segunda versão - Unexpected Embrace - primeiro, depois a Chu Zhi Ke Ji, que seria a terceira, e ao ver o este pôster ontem depois de finalmente fazer minha resenha, lembrei que tinha iniciado este drama porque gosto dos atores e resolvi finalizar, e MEU DEUS DO CÉU, que ruim que é essa primeira versão...Eles quiseram colocar N plots e arcos que parece que mais nada fazia sentido kkkk Se eu tivesse assistido na sequência correta, definitivamente teria odiado essa adaptação de novel.Achei fofo que o ML ficou todo bobo quando finalmente conseguiu namorar a FL. Mas não gostei: 1. o arco da pulseira (!?) da mãe do ML, meu Deus, só foi para encher linguiça né?2. simplesmente a doença da FL ficou esquecida depois que começaram a namorarAcho que a segunda versão Unexpected Embrace é a mais fofa no sentido de sentimentos puros, mas faz tempo que a assisti então posso estar errada, mas sem dúvidas essa é a pior de todas kkkk Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: KiRa
reviews.review_text: Overall 10 Story 10 Acting/Cast 10 Music 5.5 Rewatch Value 10 True Heroine Revenge Writing this review because there's only one other review on this drama. This one drama is a true the heroine gets her revenge, and it's complete revenge. No loose ends left, and no her being saved by a night and shining armor (though our mail lead does try). Our female lead realizes the plot against her very early on and she uses it to her advantage. Not letting anything stand in the way of her finding her own path. Our male lead belatedly realizes that he loves her and then spends four years bettering himself to be worthy of her. This is not a romance drama. This is purely a revenge drama. the only part I wish had been more complete was that at the end there had been more romance, though it was slightly implied. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Eu gostei MUITO deste drama. Apesar de ter muitos abusos e ser pesado o tema, eu gostei de como a FL foi inteligente ao perceber todas as artimanhas da 2FL e que a aproximação do ML era falsa. Não apenas isso, mas depois que o tempo passa, ela continua extremamente sagaz em suas análises e é uma personagem extremamente forte e inteligente.O drama se desenvolve muito bem, não é muito longo e nos faz ficar atentos a tudo, apesar de eu estar extremamente cansada de assistir dramas abusivos, este vendo a FL se vingar e também ter seus reconhecimentos me fez dar uma nota alta.O que eu detestei:A família dela, sem dúvidas.A 2FL, obviamente.A melhor cena é quando é revelado seu papel dentro da empresa. Mas eu também gostei de como a FL não se importou ao ser confrontada pelo ML ao revelar que sabia do plano desde o início. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 10 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 8.5 This review may contain spoilers Gentle ML, Loyal Grandma, and a Sweet Justice-Filled Romance This drama was super satisfying! Finally, the bad guys actually got what they deserved instead of just disappearing. The bullying was annoying, but the ending made up for it.The ML is honestly perfect gentle, attentive, respectful, and so loving toward the FL. No yelling, no threats, no scheming, just pure support. His grandma is amazing too so wise, caring, and protective. This is what I call a healthy C-drama family! ❤️The FL is sweet and gentle but also has a streak of steel when needed. She grows in confidence thanks to the ML and his grandma, and I loved how she completely cut ties with her toxic family.The fake daughter was hilarious in her failures every time she tried to mess things up, it backfired spectacularly 😂. And unlike most dramas, there’s no other woman constantly scheming for the ML, which made the romance feel real.I especially loved how gentle and caring the ML was in their intimate scenes. Their chemistry, plus the humor and heartfelt moments with the grandma, made this drama a really wholesome watch. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

After marriage, he went out late and came back early every day, and his freedom was bound by marriage. The rich circle was shocked, Ruan Yuan turned out to be a tigress. Originally thought to be a short-term business marriage, Ruan Yuan did not care about Pei Chi, not caring about his eating, sleeping, and his outside affairs. Later one day, Pei Chi got drunk and blocked her in the corner, blushing and angrily said: I have liked you for sixteen years, are you blind and can't see? reviews.review_text: Overall 4.5 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Frustrating drama in which FL & ML made assumptions about each other I find Yao Guan Yu visually striking so I am always drawn to his dramas. This is my second drama of his, I am unfamiliar with the main actress Zhang Qiu Zi. This drama is frustrating!What I liked:1. Yao Guan Yu - His character was a Mr Nice Guy. Yao Guan Yu had enough charm for me to finish this drama.2. Styling - I really liked ML styling including.the pyjamas, which looked expensive.3. Supporting characters - I liked ML's family because they genuinely liked FL. ML's bestie was good friend.What I disliked:1. Communication - OMG, 80% of the running time was spent on both FL & ML making assumptions about one another. Why are they not talking about their feelings. This is very frustrating!2. Antagonists - SFL was insufferable! Pei Chi was way too nice to her.3. Character development - Underdeveloped. I felt bored halfway through I started playing on my phone.Favourite sceneWhen ML's father called ML to scold him for the alleged affair Read More Was this review helpful to you?

title: Professor Xie's Girlfriend
sub_title: 谢教授你太直球了 ‧ Drama ‧ 2025
also_known_as: Professor Xie, You Are Too Straightforward , Xie Jiao Shou Ni Tai Zhi Qiu Le , 謝教授你太直球了
synopsis: Dr. Su Wan Wan's daydreams still linger on her high school secret crush, Xie Yan Ning, even eight years after graduation. What she doesn't know is that the now-renowned Professor Xie Yan Ning, celebrated for his achievements in medicine, once held a secret affection for her, too. Fate intervenes when Su Wan Wan, heading for a blind date, finds herself sharing an elevator with Xie Yan Ning, who coincidentally lives one floor below her. A misinterpretation leads her to believe he's meeting his supposed sweetheart, Zhang Yun Qing. At her own blind date, faced with a rude and disapproving mother, Su Wan Wan strategically requests an exorbitant bride price to scuttle the arrangement—a conversation inadvertently overheard by Xie Yan Ning and his friends. The misunderstandings deepen when Xie Yan Ning later witnesses Su Wan Wan helping her best friend with a wedding gift registry, leading him to mistakenly conclude she's the one getting married, prompting a hasty and rude exit. Will Su Wan Wan and Xie Yan Ning be able to navigate the misunderstandings and eight years of absence to finally realize their mutual affection? reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Finalmente um drama que explica, nem que seja um pouco, a depressão e como pode afetar a vida das pessoas vistas do lado de fora como extraordinárias e que o que não pode significar nada para você, para aquela pessoa pode ser a gota d’água.Eu gostei de como o ML se remoeu sobre suas ações com a FL depois de descobrir sobre a depressão dela e gostei dele alegar ser leigo neste assunto e o psiquiatra explicar e achei bonito a maneira que ele começou a mudar o seu comportamento e como falar com ela para que não houvesse tantos mal-entendidos e até ponderar o que e como dizer.Agora fala sério, hein? Esse homem sabe fazer cena de pegação! Pqp! O Zhang Yi Yang faz mesmo os beijos mais secos parecerem a última gota de água do planeta terra kkkkkkApesar do final, pelo menos o do link que eu vi, acabar no carro após o confronto final com a vaca da mãe e a vaca da irmã da FL, o encontro com a família biológica não aconteceu, mas sinceramente eu até prefiro quando é assim, porque já sabemos mais ou menos qual seria o roteiro né. kkkkkk Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.5 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers I disliked the weird plot but must say Jiang Song was the best part of this drama I was in the mood for Sun Qian Xun's dramas so I picked this drama because the poster was quite striking & the drama was quite popular when it was fresh release. I didn't know what to expect when I clicked play and when the drama ended, I felt disappointed.What I liked:1. Jiang Song - He was the most fascinating character in this drama. Wonderfully portrayed by Li Xing Lin - he was charismatic and had strong screen presence. 2. Suitors - I am always disappointed with vertical dramas that have multiple suitors because of the lack of character development. Not this drama - Li Ming Lan & Jiang Song had strong arcs with the other two was ok despite shorter screentime. The ensemble worked well together and I loved watching their dynamics.3. Production - High production value. Drama looked sleek & expensive.4. Supporting characters - I liked ML's Assistant Wang. I also liked the youngest suitor.5. Visuals - The suitors & Li Yuan were handsome. What I disliked:1. Charade - Such a complicated charade concocted by Li Ming Lan and agreed by FL to make Li Ming Lan's white moon light jealous. From the fake marriage to fake pregnancy, I found both Li Ming Lan & FL were dumb.2. Banquet - ML's grandfather's birthday banquet was a mess! From the silly buddhist beads debate to the swimming pool incident - gosh it was ridiculous.3. Main characters - I didn't like both FL & ML. As said earlier FL was dumb & ML was too bland.4. Romance - Longtime crush made complicated. Their romance was rooted in nostalgia.5. Shen Zhi Zhi - She did so much mess but was not punished. I also didn't get the need to fundraise for her lab - why must it involved Li Ming Lan's friends.
