reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.5 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Decent watch for remarriage drama. I quite like Meng Na and Liang Siwei work together. Since i like their first collab and not fond of their second collab. I tried to watch with little faith.Plot is about FL is washed-up movie star who, to pay off her debts, tries to regain her former glory. She's tricked into participating in a dating reality show, only to discover that the show's director is actually the brother of her ex-husband.The entire plot revolves around the dating reality show, with the ML going to great lengths to prevent the FL from creating CP with other male contestants. At the same time, he provides her with considerable help and care on set. During their time together, they find that their relationship seems to have returned to what it once was. ML works even harder to remarry, and the two finally confess their feelings. FL explains the reason for the divorce: they spent too little time together, and neither supported the other during major events. She felt marriage shouldn't be like that, and coupled with being manipulated by the SFL,FL misunderstood ML, leading to the divorce. The plot is average. But for the chemistry between the leads still sufficient and enjoy to watch.Recommended if you like divorce back to remarriage troupe. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Romance reconciliation and main characters lacked depth I have a weekly column on r/CShortHaven about two dramas adapted from the same source. Good friend (both MDL & reddit) thehepburn informed me about this drama. I watched Cheng Cheng's version almost immediately after it was released and was vaguely aware of the other version starring Meng Na and Liang Si Wei. This drama is a letdown.What I liked:1. Acting - I consider chemistry as part of acting and yes, there was good chemistry between Meng Na and Liang Si Wei. Both were also good in their individual roles. I liked the performance by the actor who played assistant director, ML's friend in glasses.2. Flashbacks - I liked those scenes when they were harmonious and in love.3. Supporting characters - I liked the assistant director, FL's agent / manager and ML's mom. The guy who partnered with FL was not bad. 4. Styling - Meng Na was beautiful despite given weird outfits (I was expecting her to wear a tie dye dress that complements her on-screen partner but nope). Liang Si Wei gave off Angus Young of AC/DC vibe with his boyish outfits (perhaps because he was didi). The best outfit for him is definitely the towel.5. Tone - Lighthearted. I chuckled a lot during the first half of the drama. What I disliked:1. ML actions - At the beginning of their working relationship, he sabotaged FL's screen time and shots. I knew he was overprotective (i.e. he didn't like her getting attention from other men) but it was not a cool move. 2. Romance - Sadly the romance lacked depth. I was frustrated that the romance arc focused mostly on push dynamics (with ML being a jerk but at the same time trying to win her back). They broke up because lack of communication that could have been avoided if they were frank with each other. To me, they got back together based on nostalgia.3. Main characters - Underwritten. I understood that FL was making a career comeback through the variety show but nothing was elaborated about her personal and professional goal. Why was she under the radar? She was secretly married so a divorce wouldn't hurt her career. Favourite sceneThe cooking segment of the variety show Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 3.0 Rewatch Value 9.5 This review may contain spoilers Spicy Romance with Tsundere ML I watched this since i liked Tian Tianyi and Wang Zilin previous work and my hunch was right. The drama has better plot and chemistry than before.Plot is about FL who seduced ML without her knowing he was FL's scumbag fiance uncle and got one-night stand. They met again with FL's scumbag fiance and his mistress. ML blackmail FL into relationship since he never lose from his nephew and FL agrees since she needs ML to take revenge against her family and her fianceLike how Tian Tianyi lipstick was smugded after the kisses, the tension was right and not too vulgar.I quite like ML characterization feels like tiger outside but little cat inside when he knows FL was lying to him. The ending was satisfying, the bad guys got their retribution and the couple got their deserved ending.Recommended to watch. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

synopsis: Framed and sent to prison by the real heiress, "fool's gold" Shen Yue is reborn after falling into a pond in her last life. Knowing her own outcome and feeling she will eventually be sent to prison and die young, Shen Yue drastically changes her behavior and outlook on her own family, trying to enjoy her good life until the real daughter returns. Her sudden change prompts her emotionally distant elder brothers to become closer not only to her but to one another as well. Upon real heiress Shen Hui's return, Shen Yue discards the "fake vs real" script and decides they're real sisters. These subtle changes snowball to forever transform the family dynamic, ultimately avoiding Shen Yue's tragic fate. (Source: MyDramaList) ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Jiu Suan Shi Jia Qian Jin Ye Yao Yong Gan Bai Lan" (就算是假千金也要勇敢摆烂) by Ji Fu Ran (纪扶染). English Español Português (Brasil) 한국어

synopsis: After disappearing for three months, her fiancé Huo Zhen Zhou unexpectedly returns with amnesia—along with the wife he has just married. Furious, Li Su impulsively enters a flash marriage with her former fiancé’s look-alike younger brother, Huo Xuan Ye, thinking it’s simply a mutually beneficial arrangement. But for Huo Xuan Ye, this is a long-cherished crush finally coming true. As they spend more time together, Li Su slowly falls for him and discovers the secret, years-long affection he has hidden. (Source: Chinese = 红果短剧 app || Translation = MyDramaList) ~~ Adapted from the web novel "Wei Hun Fu Shi Yi Ling Qu Ta Ren, Wo Shan Hun Ta Di" (未婚夫失忆另娶他人，我闪婚他弟) by Jin Yu Zi (今与紫). reviews.author: addicted_2_dramas
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 6.5 Rewatch Value 9.0 This review may contain spoilers Explosive Chemistry Okay, the brother didn't just have amnesia. He had a whole personality change and I love that the main leads called him out on it. The 2FL was shortsighted. She could have stayed quietly by the 2MLs side and he likely would never have found out what she did. On that note, why do you owe someone your whole life if they saved your life. It sets the groundwork for people pretending to save people and them making astronomical requests of the person they "saved." Case in point.A standout scene was when Liang Si Wei (ML) begged her to choose him and like him. It reminded me of Meredith Grey in the elevator scene in Grey's anatomy. I was scared it was foreshadowing a breakup but thankfully it didn't. The leads had explosive chemistry that translated really well on the screen. It was hard to remember they weren't a real couple. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.5 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Average Plot with Awesome Acting. I watched this drama and for the adaptation nothing could beat this version. The age gap looks so real but somehow it fits the drama. The chemistry between the Feng Ming Chao and Meng Na is excellent. Their kisses are emotional, logical, and psychologically engaging.For simple plot, FL was being orphan and raised by the ML. They appear to be siblings, but are not actually related by blood. FL has secretly loved the ML since childhood, and he has always doted on her, seemingly waiting for her to grow up. So overall, it's very sweet, with no angst.Meng Na was truly beautiful; even that hime-cut looked good on her. She could be both cool and sweet, very sassy when dealing with scumbags, and very sweet when facing ML. I liked her when she hugged ML it was very naturally cute.Feng Ming Chao was too thin but he seems well-suited for this type of aloof, domineering older man. His acting skills, having experience in long drama are unlikely to be bad. And his real-life as a father also lends him an edge in portraying older characters.Supporting characters are just so-so. The various villainous female supporting characters and extras in the short drama are nothing special, but there aren't any particularly bad either.This is obviously on-budget drama but the acting was decent to watch. reviews.author: Sana
reviews.review_text: Overall 3.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 10 Rewatch Value 2.0 This review may contain spoilers I watched “Miss Qiao’s Top White Moonlight” version of this story first, and I genuinely liked it — mainly because of the romance build-up between the characters. When I found out there were other versions, I decided to give this one a try, especially because the storyline was familiar and Megna, one of my favorite short vertical drama actresses, was part of it. I honestly thought, what could go wrong with a familiar story and a favorite actress?Well… I was very wrong.This version completely ruined the slow-burn romance that made the story appealing in the first place. The emotional pacing felt off, and instead of letting feelings develop naturally, the drama made choices that were uncomfortable rather than romantic.One particular aspect that really put me off was the portrayal of the uncle character. He is neither blood-related nor in any romantic commitment with the FL, yet repeatedly pulling her onto his lap and engaging in overly physical behavior felt unnecessary and disturbing. It didn’t come across as affectionate or protective — it was simply uncomfortable to watch. Honestly, I don’t think even a real-life father would behave this way with his grown daughter, let alone an uncle.On top of that, the FL’s styling, especially her haircut, was extremely distracting — easily one of the worst I’ve seen, and it did her no favors.Overall, this adaptation failed to capture what made the story special: emotional restraint, slow-burn tension, and respectful relationship dynamics. Compared to the “Miss Qiao’s Top White Moonlight” version, this one felt rushed, poorly executed, and tonally confusing. A disappointing watch, especially when the source material had so much potential. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

Já o Feng Ming Chao, sua maquiagem o deixou com aparência bem mais velha, mas seu figurino era ok. Mas pelo menos sua personagem dava porrada em quem precisava, nem sempre, mas dava kkkk 90% do caos dela resolveria com a opção "Bloquear" no telefone kkkkkML: As ações dele não eram tão agradáveis, seu personagem era mais autoritário/passivo-agressivo do que amoroso/afetuoso. 2ML: escroto escroto escroto, agressivo, abusivo, tudo que tem direito. reviews.review_text: Overall 9.5 Story 10 Acting/Cast 10 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 10 Title: What a Well Behaved Girl (2025) is a well done romance miniseries with Yang Pengcheng (as Duan Xiuming & Duan Xiuzhi) and Long Xi (as Lu Mingye & Lu Mingyu) in the leading couple’s role. The cast did a good job bringing their characters to life but Yang Pencheng and Long Xi really did great performing such complex characters that can send shivers up the spine. Duan Xiumin, because of his status in the Duan family, behaved like a care free person with deep responsibilities and Lu Mingyu, after years of physical and emotional abuse, learned how to masked her feeling in order to protect herself from becoming weak at the hands of her abusive family. It was riveting to see how Xiuming broke through Mingyu’s emotional barriers and planted the seed of love with his devotion, love, and fierceness protection toward her. This drama is quite impressive and entertaining, enjoy it!This drama can be found on YouTube under the caption: What a Well-Behaved Girl【Full】Cold-Hearted Heiress and Ruthless Protector Read More Was this review helpful to you?

Todos os beijos foram mornos, sem abrir a boca, só virando a cabeça, se fosse em uma porta teria mais emoção!A FL que tinha uma postura extremamente fria e calculista parecia um robô nos momentos íntimos com o ML, que por sua vez sua postura extremamente possessiva o deixava autoritário e controlador ao extremo.A família da FL então nem se fala, mas as duas amigas foram boas para ela. Ao mesmo tempo que esse drama tem MUITO tempo de tela, de momentos mais diários, parecia que os dialogos principais realmente só aconteceram em uma cena, que foi a da pintura da fênix, o resto tudo o amigo do ML quem descobriu.Essa é a quarta versão que assisto, acho que é a pior até agora, vamos ver as próximas, já que estou maratonando novamente os títulos aqui listados porque na época eu só compartilhei meu ponto de vista sobre o do Ke Chun. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 3.0 This review may contain spoilers Lighthearted comedy about couple afraid of communicating their true feelings I watched this drama because I was preparing a reddit post on Han Jia Hui dramas. I had never seen Yu Lun Hao dramas before so I was curious about the pairing. Overall, I enjoyed the drama.What I liked:1. Tone - Light hearted comedy.2. Acting - This drama allowed Han Jia Hui to shine because of the comedic moments. Yu Lun Hao also gave good performance. I like their chemistry.3. Supporting characters - ML's mother was a surprise - she was skeptical of FL but once she met her, she liked her instantly. I also liked her bestie (the actress looked like same actresswho played HJH's bestie in Midsummer Love Story), assistant Lin, ML's father.4. Romance - A lot of kisses although at times they felt a way for ML to avoid confrontations. ML loved to carry FL princess style. There were also tender moments for example FL cooking for ML, office antics.5. Styling - I loved FL's outfits because they suited her skintone. However her bestie kept wearing the same mustard dress.What I disliked:1. Antagonist - Lu Ming was a snob.2. Communication - Their bodies were more honest about their feelings than their mouths / hearts. The lack of frank conversations frustrated me. 3. ML's action - I found ML to be controlling and it was off-putting.Favourite sceneWhen FL first met ML's mother Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers Very likeable characters with spicy & sweet romance and sizzling chemistry I got to know about this drama from a sub-reddit when a member posted a review. This is my third drama of Zhang Ruo Chen - I love her when she played a forensic scientist. I had never watched Wang Zi Yi's dramas before. I was informed that there are multiple adaptation of this plot and this version is the first adaptation that I watched. I must say I enjoyed this drama immensely and could watch this drama multiple times. What I liked:1. Acting - I must say that Zhang Ruo Chen's charm made the character so likeable that it's easy to forgive her bad wife past. I also enjoyed Wang Zi Yi's acting. Both of them had sizzling chemistry that their scenes together were so delightful to watch.2. FL characterisation - Ok I watched Zhang Lei's adaption. I can't remember her leading lady's name but she had "mean" vibe in her FL. Zhang Ruo Chen's FL was compassionate with ML and her father once she got the inside scoop from the "audience". She was also smart & cheeky in managing her cousin & the guy she used to have a crush on.3. Romance - Damn, that first spicy scene was 🔥. Their make out scenes were hot too because desire was felt in both of them. I love their sweet scenes especially the love letter & Kim Seon Ho's infamous pose. I loved that they communicated regularly with FL confronting ML on his jealousy. I also liked them for having fun, being affectionate and teasing SFL & SML 4. ML characterisation - I liked ML because he was very likeable. Wang Zi Yi's ML didn't seem as desperate to please FL as Zhang Lei's FL.5. Supporting character - I really liked FL's father whose character was kind and amusing. What I disliked:1. Public comments - I wasn't used to this format of public comments appearing on screen so I was overwhelmed. They also appeared on screen at a breakneck speed in the beginning of the drama so it was hard for me to keep up & understand the info. 2. Antagonists - OMG FL's cousin who is SFL is not only manipulative but also irritating. She calling out FL to announce the arrival of SML was just plain rude.Favourite sceneWhen ML showed FL's love letter for him to SML & SFL Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 8.0 This review may contain spoilers Chinese vertical drama with the best VFX, action sequences & the most Kdrama vibe I am a fan of fantasy / supernatural tv series. When a reddit friend told me that this drama is similar to Korean drama My Demon, my interest was piqued. To be honest, I dropped My Demon because the poor writing did not meet my expectation. However for Along with the Gods / Bound to the God, I had little expectations. I was extremely impressed by the quality of this drama and enjoyed it immensely.What I liked:1. FL characterisation - I instantly liked FL Shen Yu Zhen right from the beginning because she acted like a shrewd businesswoman and negotiated terms & conditions of the partnership with ML, unlike the FL in My Demon (she just accepted ML’s terms & conditions blindly). 2. ML characterisation - I liked ML a lot! He enjoyed his role as god but wasn’t cocky (unlike the ML in My Demon - he seemed to loathe his work). He was nice and honest with FL.3. Writing - Along with the Gods is a Chinese vertical drama with the most Kdrama vibe. Kudos to the writer of Along with the Gods for making this drama an improved version of My Demon. Along with the Gods has depth and maturity that My Demon lacks.4. VFX - I was impressed by the visual effects - I must say it has one of the best VFX and action sequences in the world of vertical dramas.5. Romance - I liked the romance arc - slow burn with good push-and-pull dynamics. There was even a little twist in the third act - past lives & reincarnation, which pays homage to My Demon but wasn’t draggy. 6. Acting - Great performances by both Sun Qian Xun & Li Bo Yan. SQX is known more for her comedic roles - Shen Yu Zhen is one of the few serious characters that SQX has portrayed and she nailed the role. Along with the Gods really showcased Li Bo Yan’s acting prowess - his character has a big role in this drama. It was cool to see Li Bo Yan fight baddies! We already know that there is great chemistry between SQX and LBY so I was convinced by the romance arc.7. Family - It is the core theme of this drama. FL is adopted granddaughter of a rich lady and I liked that the grandmother did not chose her biological granddaughter as the heir - she chose based on merit. 8. Styling - Wonderful wardrobe for FL & ML. I wrote a reddit post about this combo of black pleather jacket - white shirt - black tie - black trousers before watching this drama. So I chuckled when I saw Li Bo Yan wearing this ensemble. He looked very handsome of course!What I disliked:1. Antagonists - FL's sister was greedy and evil with her husband being her Mr Yes Man / follower. Fang Hang Xing was alos evil and manipulative. Good thing all three got their retribution.Favourite sceneWhen ML asked for a kiss from FL Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: BingedAndBroken
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.5 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 9.0 This review may contain spoilers Divine Contracts, High-Stakes Power Games, and a Mini Drama That Deserved a Full Series 📝 Review(WARNING: Potential Spoilers — I’m Not Saving You from Any Emotional Damage)This mini drama had no business being as entertaining as it was—and yet, here we are.Bound to the God is one of those short-form dramas you start casually and then suddenly realize you’ve watched twenty episodes without blinking. Yes, the premise will remind you of My Demon, and no, that didn’t bother me in the slightest. If anything, it made me wish even more that this had been given a full-length treatment.Li Bo Yan absolutely carries this drama. He’s charismatic, visually striking, and leans fully into that “supernatural protector with questionable morals” energy. At times he gave me serious Jackson Wang vibes, which… helped. A lot. I would not have complained if this had been a Chinese full-series counterpart to My Demon—the bones are there, and the appeal absolutely is too.What also stood out was the central opposing force—not mystical, not supernatural, but operating on pure influence and control. The conflict leans heavily into tech, money, and far-reaching resources, giving the story a modern, grounded edge. It’s less magic-versus-magic and more power-versus-power, which actually works well within the short-drama format.Because this was watched through user-uploaded YouTube clips, the music was often muted or cut entirely, making it difficult to judge. Thankfully, the pacing, performances, and concept were engaging enough that the lack of audible OST didn’t detract from the experience.Ultimately, Bound to the God is fast, entertaining, and frustrating only in the sense that it clearly could have been more. If this concept were ever expanded into a full series, I’d watch it without hesitation.💭 Final Mood“Entertained, mildly feral, and wishing this had been 16 full episodes instead of two-minute crumbs.” Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 6.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 4.5 This review may contain spoilers Treat this as NPC drama I watched this last year and this is the most recent drama from Zhang Jinyi and Lu Huanyu. For me this drama is ultimately for hardcore fans and CP fans. It was pretty mediocre. Plot is about FL is controlled and manipulated by her uncle, but she endures her suffering to avenge her parents. ML is the weapon she lured into her life, wielding immense power. The beginning of the plot is very engaging; FL's appearance playing the piano is stunning. Plus, she gets two kills right at the start. However, the subsequent plot weakens. ML is overly enthusiastic, while the FL seems to be taking things too hard. She uses ML as a tool, but her methods of revenge are not satisfying to watch. With sufficient evidence, she could have easily caught and killed the bad guys, but she went through all that trouble for using inefficient method.The costumes and props are good, and the plot is another Good Girl adaptation, but the story is poorly written. FL's initial portrayal of a villain is quite compelling, but she becomes less so later, becoming rather mediocre and flat. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

Unfortunately, she met the royal officer investigating corruption in the city and tthe handsome officer fell in-loved with the beautiful girl who was also virtuous and very intelligent. He supported her, helped her and protected her from harm and became her hand, her knife and her sword to avenge against those who made her suffer so much.Their acting are simple but very convincing. reviews.author: Bijou
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.5 This review may contain spoilers Its really She was the man (2006) coded. I watched this last year and this drama reminds me of J Drama Hana Kimi (2007) and American Movie She was the man (2006). It feels like nostalgic drama to my youth. Sun Qian Xun and Wang Jiamao embraced their character smoothy.I always love "woman disguised as a man" premise and lighthearted narrative style, it stands out in the short drama genre. The Sun Qian Xun as FL disguises herself as a man to attend classes in place of her brother, unexpectedly becoming the school's most popular girl and attracting the attention of the school bully, ML. (This is so She was the man coded).I like how Sun Qian Xun boys looks not too beautiful like flower next door type yet strikingly cool and believable as a man. I like the moment ML realized he actually was gay by liking FL in boys costume. FL completely deceives ML, yet he remains devoted to her. The cons are last 10 minutes are a bit too convoluted. After being rejected, ML plans to publicly confess his feelings. And when the disguised was being discovered they used fake amnesia plot. And when couple progression was slighty better the sudden ML disappearance annoyed me. SFL was weak in attacking FL but constantly bouncing around.The final punishment was just a demerit summary: I think the drama was generally average, with some blunders and minor laughs, but I didn't like the later parts. The romance was so-so and the chemistry between Wang Jiamao and Sun Qianxun seems like artificial, they look better as comrade more than lovers for my view.Although the plot is simple, its still decent to watch. reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 10 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 10 This review may contain spoilers A atriz tem talento para interpretar com naturalidade um homem. Não sei porque enrolei tanto para assistir esse drama, eu dei muita risada!Que história divertida, leve e gostosa de assistir, apesar de ter uma malinha como 2FL.A atriz Sun Qian Xun foi simplesmente PERFEITA em sua atuação. Ela não forçou um trejeito masculino exagerado ao interpretar o Jiang Chen e nem nada, foi extremamente natural e convincente. Seu figurino também era muito bom na maioria das vezes, apesar da camisa preta realçar um pouco seus seios, o que seria fácil do ML identificar, mas o resto era muito impecável convencer, o corpo e a linha nos ombros ficaram muito naturais. E quando estava sendo ela, como Hai Xi, seu figurino realçava seu corpo e sua beleza. Eu a conhecia do drama "Dote On (穿书求生指南：请勿对NPC动心)", mas infelizmente não segui a acompanhando porque na época não havia mais dramas cadastrados e hoje a surpresa maravilhosa ao reencontrá-la nesta história. Sua atuação, sem sombra de dúvidas, mostra que ela tem um talento incrível.Já o ator Wang Jia Mao, foi ótimo também em seu papel de playboy, suas roupas eram bonitas também e seu personagem bem escrito, gostaria que ele tivesse tido mais questionamentos ao identificar que gostava do Jiang Chen, mas gostei da sua determinação e coragem. É óbvio que se formos analisar racionalmente, era muito mais fácil a FL ter dito o inverso desde o início do que essa confusão toda, mas isso não vem ao caso, não pense, só se divirta assistindo porque realmente vale a pena.Tiveram várias cenas das quais eu gostei bastante, como quando ele se declara com os fogos de artifícios, ela no hospital e eles jogando sinuca a primeira vez e até a FL como homem seduzindo a 2FL kkkkkkk Read More Was this review helpful to you?

synopsis: The Lin family in Jiangcheng once received medical teachings from Yun Miao and became a famous family of miracle doctors. Before her death, the Lin family matriarch wrote in her will, earnestly hoping that Yun Miao would one day visit their home. Unfortunately, the descendants of the Lin family had no respect for Yun Miao whatsoever. Instead, they repeatedly made things difficult for her, showed her little courtesy, and even brought out the current patriarch of the Lin family—Jiangcheng’s top doctor—to suppress Yun Miao. What they didn’t know was that the patriarch’s medical skills were originally passed down from Yun Miao herself. synopsis: Li Wan Wan followed Rong Xing Ye for three years, gambling everything, only to suffer a crushing defeat. After a crisis, she vanished completely. No one expected that the powerful and arrogant Rong Xing Ye would go mad like this. He would search high and low to find this woman. When they met again, he used every means at his disposal, seeking nothing more than to imprison her in his heart for eternity! reviews.author: Rhody401
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 1.0 Rewatch Value 9.0 ? She Gave Him Three Years—Losing Her Made Him Realize Everything One of those short dramas where I really enjoyed both the storyline and the performances. The ML and FL did an excellent job bringing their complicated relationship to life, especially the emotional change that happens once Li Wan Wan finally disappears.For three years, Wan Wan follows Rong Xing Ye and gives everything she has to their relationship, only to eventually realize that loving someone shouldn't mean continuously losing yourself. After everything falls apart, she doesn't simply threaten to leave—she disappears completely.That is when Rong Xing Ye finally changes.The powerful, arrogant man who seemed so confident that Wan Wan would always be there suddenly becomes desperate to find her. I enjoyed watching the balance between them shift. When she was chasing him, he could take her presence for granted. Once she was gone, he became the one unable to let go.When they finally meet again, his feelings are no longer something he can ignore. His determination to keep her becomes intense, possessive, and sometimes overwhelming, which fits perfectly with the title *Cage of Love*.Both actors were excellent. The FL made Wan Wan's pain and determination believable, while the ML convincingly changed from arrogant and emotionally controlled to a man almost consumed by the fear of losing her again. Their chemistry made the emotional scenes even stronger.Sometimes you don't understand someone's place in your life until the silence they leave behind becomes unbearable. ❤️🔥 Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Enfim.... Zhao Yang Si Wo (2025) é melhor. Impossível este drama estar completo nos links que encontrei, se há 70 episódios de 2 minutos cada, era para ter 140 minutos, então isso interfere e MUITO no desenvolvimento da história, porque há falas que a FL disse ao se desculpar, de coisas que nem em flashbacks foram mostradas. Mas enfim, Zhao Yang Si Wo (2025) é melhor. Eu gosto da atriz Chen Yu Ling e do Wang Xuan, mas nossa, que FL irritante! Ela era muito imatura, talvez nessa adaptação ela não tivesse 25 anos já que o ML tinha 29 e fez 30 ao longo do drama, mas suas roupas eram muito infantis para qualquer tipo de ambiente de trabalho e suas ações também. Já o ML, não me convenceu, acredito que seja o roteiro, já que o ator Wang Xuan já desempenhou papéis mais firmes com facilidade. Ambos eram muito imprudentes no ambiente de trabalho, principalmente o ML com o seu ciúmes, apesar de eu entender que ele nunca havia sentido isso e poderia não saber como reagir. E sinceramente, depois de assistir Zhao Yang Si Wo, é impossível achar qualquer outra versão a altura. Os beijos eram ótimos, mas de resto, terrível, não gostei também das mudanças feitas na história. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: WLbina
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.5 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 10 Music 8.5 Rewatch Value 9.0 Nice story , great actors So , I had this one for a time on my watchlist , but today I saw a short and so I searched a link to the full and was nicely suprised. It is a nice story with all the elements of a VCdrama but little bit better done. I don't want to spoil anything for you guys so my review is going to have a lack of explanation of the plot but more about the Characters .ML - I'm a fan of LSW, love his smile and his shameless way wich only he can carry to feel natural and not greasy . In this Drama he is a bit more mature, he likes the FL and he protects her in his own way , even if it does not seem like it until later. He has some problems but by the time they are solved ,missunderstandings happen.FL- I also like MLJ , she plays a heiress hardworking in a company, she is not weak or a pushover , she is strong and independent but she is also in love with the ML .She thinks that he was pressured to marry her and doesn't love her. As she encounters Problems , she keeps them for her self and so the Drama starts . The biggest Problem is the lack of communication (what else 😅)Other Characters - FL's BF I loved her , she is a good Friend and she is funny, so is ML's Friend , I loved their presence . FL's "Elder brother " -even if he is protective and he loves her , he does not seem to be a bad person . ML's wannabe fiance -bad as always in any other drama .. the "3rd guy" a interessting development.Best scene : when all 3 guy appear at her home 😅It is a nice drama and it is highly possible for me to rewatch it. reviews.review_text: Overall 5.5 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 5.5 This review may contain spoilers I'm not having it with the plot. I remember i had watched the same plot with Wang Bo as the Male Lead (I quite forget the Female Lead name) and seeing Ma Lejie and Liang Siwei took this script i want to see what is the difference.The Plot is basically about FL who want to divorce ML due his indifference behaviour to her and to her surprised she was pregnant. The tug of war drama is finally started.First of all i quite like Ma Lejie acting as heiress and she is quite hardworking but she lacks of dignity when she fall in love with ML. Liang Siwei acting was fine but i don't like how inconsistent writer wrote ML character (just like Wang Bo version since they are basically same script). Actually the problem was communication and the misunderstanding is quickly solved while they pushed more tug of war to make another male lead who pursue FL (the younger one aka 3ML is unnecessary for me).Only recommend to watch only one. Even if you are fan of both of the actor. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: addicted_2_dramas
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 3.0 This review may contain spoilers Script ✔️ Acting ✔️ Producing ? While I like the two leads individually and they have good chemistry together, the script was just no. There were also so many post/pre-production errors that were noticeable and took away from the actual enjoyment of the show. There were at least 2 if not 3 Wardrobes inconsistencies within scenes and just her stomach sizing was inconsistent throughout the show. A pregnancy progresses (meaning gets larger in nature) not has a tiny bump depending on which outfit the actress was wearing. If the actresses looks were such an issue perhaps it would have been a better idea to skip the whole twins storyline. I have never heard of a woman with a flat belly pregnant with twins at 5 months. It's not medically possible, I mean you can deliver and save the babies at that point.... Moving on-ish: what woman hell-bent on keeping her babies goes drinking and dancing in a club? Again, at about 5 months pregnancy with TWINS?! I'm convinced that no one in the writing, editing, or production team has ever been pregnant, known someone pregnant, or read a basic book on pregnancy. The random fainting due to blood sugar? No. She's pregnant. Rant over. The FL and MLs friends were both great. I wish there was a way to find out the actors information. Overall, I have seen this storyline almost a dozen times and while not my favorite (entirely due to writing/production and this version of the characters) they did a great job. reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers A sinopse que consta neste drama está muito errada, ela não desaparece, ela apenas pede o divórcio e não se passa anos depois do divórcio para que eles se reencontrem - vou tentar atualizar, mas enfim, só para avisar...Este drama é mais um com enredo de o quanto o marido é negligente com a esposa para causar muitos mal-entendidos e tem uma mãe asquerosa que tenta o manipular a todo instante e causa uma ruptura em seu casamento. Eu simplesmente amo o ator Liang Si Wei e a atriz Ma Le Jie (apesar dela sempre fazer esse tipo de papel), então assisti por causa deles. O ML não dá a devida atenção a FL enquanto são casados, porque estava tentando mostrar seu valor para garantir um futuro, mas a sua frieza afasta a FL e a interferência da 2FL faz com que ela desista e queira ir embora. Apesar de ser o plot que eu mais detesto, este ML, toda vez que a FL falava alguma coisa que demonstrava desconforto, ele agia em silêncio, seja tentando afastar sua assistente, trocando-a por um homem e etc, então isso é um ponto positivo. Mas infelizmente como sempre a bruxa da mãe dele manipulava as coisas para que a 2FL estivesse lá. Enfim, como o drama é longo (2 horas e 51 minutos), nem todo mundo vai ter a paciência de assistí-lo. Mas gostei do 2ML, ele foi um bom amigo dela. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: oppa_
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 4.5 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 4.5 This review may contain spoilers At first glance, this drama feels pleasant—a healing, sweet love story. But beneath the charm, it leans more toward fake fantasy than grounded storytelling.The central romance strains believability: a man with autism, who isn’t rich, powerful, or exceptionally handsome, so easily finds a beautiful young woman who not only agrees to date him but also goes out of her way to do so much for him. He doesn’t openly express love, romance, or affection, yet she still falls for him unconditionally.In real life, an average-looking man with autism would rarely attract such effortless devotion, especially without status, wealth, or some compelling reason for the woman’s interest. Chinese society’s reality is very different—we often see marriage programs where even 40-year-old brides demand millionaires. Against that backdrop, a stunning 28-year-old woman, model-level attractive, chasing an autistic man “just because,” feels less like reality and more like a wish-fulfillment fantasy for introverted men.It might have worked better if the show had given the female lead a believable reason to enter this relationship first—practical, emotional, or circumstantial—and then allowed love to grow naturally. Without that, her instant attraction feels fake and leaves viewers constantly asking “Why is this happening?”For comparison:In older Korean dramas with autistic or socially challenged male leads, the story usually shows hesitation, resistance, or at least a struggle before romance.Good Doctor (Korean version) portrayed an autistic genius doctor; even with his brilliance and closeness to the heroine, she initially hesitated to see him as a partner.Another drama with an autistic chaebol still depicted the female lead as though marrying him was a burden, despite his wealth.By contrast, The Wonderful World skips realism and dives straight into dreamland—a fantasy where any introverted or autistic man can imagine being loved unconditionally by a perfect woman, without needing to bridge the gap between reality and romance. reviews.author: John Hart
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 6.0 Acting/Cast 9.5 Music 7.5 Rewatch Value 5.0 INSANELY CHARMING, PAINFULLY CONTRIVED In some ways this series is trash. In other ways it's transcendent. I've never experienced a story so conflicted this way. So let me tell you right now it's a soft recommend -- a great show for your heart, but a migraine for your brain.I normally would have abandoned a series this contrived. All sorts of things happen because of 'fate', which is a poor screenwriting trick. And it's such a shame because the characters are so endearing.The core question of this series is: what would you do if you discovered you had a doppleganger? Someone who looked exactly like you, but behaved differently. In Western stories this would be an actual twin brother somehow separated at birth, but I love how the Eastern story simple accepts the doppleganger as real and proceeds forward.The problem is that from this point forward the writer/director filmed a really rough draft. He needed input from another writer to make this thing make sense -- and there's SO MUCH WRONG here.1. Characters ping-ping between cities in contrived confusing ways. Towards the end of the series I honestly lost track of which city we were in half the time. The entire series should have been set in Beijing. 2. We have four main characters: Memory Issues Li Qin, Ballerina, Photographer Boy, and his clone Qipao Boy. The story struggles with having these characters all cross paths by coincidence again and again and again. There was no need for this. The first time the boys crossed paths was fine, but after that --3. -- these four characters should have become fast friends. Eliminating the need for coincidence entirely. They should have been friends before the major plot twist happened. A month or so would have made the looming tragedy 12 times more tragic.If you've made it this far, you have a feeling you should pass. You're probably right. But I was happy to watch these characters despite the illogical elements of the script.Here's why --1. The male lead isn't your run of the mill Idol Drama Pretty Boy. Instead he plays two different roles really well. I definitely want to see more of this guy.2. The ballerinas are fantastic because... they're actual ballerinas! Instead of tiny emaciated actresses buried in makeup, they're simply fit young ladies that exude beauty. The lead ballerina is TERRIFIC and I'll watch anything with her going forward. Her emotional depth is the anchor of this show. Her snarky best friend literally has almost no credits on MDL but is so natural she steals half the show.3. What brought me here is Li Qin and her constant ability to pick interesting stories. Her role is so delightfully different for her and yet she's pulling of her subtle acting thing yet again. She can smile with a slight tear in her eye and kill me everything. The problem is her character's psychological flaws are so all over the place that even the great Li Qin can't quite fix her.Reviewing this is so hard. Let me say I loved the performances, loved the ballet, loved the young actors, loved what they tried to do with the story, but felt the page by page story became an embarrassing mess after Episode 17. Yet there was something about these characters and actors that got me to the end just the same.I guess I'd say give this a try. If it grabs you a little, see it through. If not at all, run away, lol. reviews.review_text: Overall 6.0 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 good executed romantic and investigating drama Synopsis:The female lead’s brother, a dedicated police officer, is gravely injured on duty and falls into a coma. Before the coma, he entrusts his close friend and colleague the male lead with the responsibility of looking after his younger sister, who works as a reporter now . The male lead doesn’t marry her out of obligation, but because he had already fallen for her long before. However, the female lead is unaware of his true feelings and believes the marriage is just a formality or duty. As the story progresses, the couple slowly opens up to each other, sharing their thoughts and feelings, eventually realizing and accepting that they genuinely love one another.My Take:The execution of the story was very well done. The couple loved eachother , and the cast overall was strong. I especially enjoyed the bromance between the male lead and his brother-in-law their camaraderie added a pull and push ,warm and emotional touch to the narrative. This isn’t just a love story; it also weaves in a parallel crime investigation plot, which moved at a steady and engaging pace. The storyline had the right flow and balance between romance and investigation.However, one aspect that disappointed me was the female lead’s performance. Her acting or perhaps her character's portrayal felt restrained, as if she was holding herself back and not fully immersing into the role.Overall, it was a good drama worth watching. reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 6.0 This review may contain spoilers Investigação e romance reais Eu estou bem satisfeita com essa leva de dramas verticais que estão sendo lançados recentemente. As histórias finalmente estão diversificando!A sinopse básica (sem spoilers) do drama é: O irmão da FL é policial/investigador e é ferido em serviço, e pede ao amigo/capitão que cuide bem de sua irmã mais nova. O ML então promete a FL que será responsável por ela, cuidando dela e ao atingir a idade se casará com ela. Ai pula o tempo, eles estão casados. A FL é repórter e o ML diretor/capitão de operações secretas (pelo o que eu entendi - legenda automática as vezes é uma bagunça). E ai o drama de fato começa... e aqui terá SPOILERS..A FL está cobrindo um caso de "serial killer" (pra mim aquilo é serial killer, afinal de contas o cara mata todas as mulheres e corta suas mãos). E ao se deparar com o pai e brigar com ele na rua, acaba sendo vista pelo suspeito do caso... Ela vai na cena do crime mais recente e se depara com o marido e os policiais, mas ninguém sabe que eles são casados (aparentemente eles são realmente recém-casados), na sequência se encontra com o suspeito em uma balada e acaba sendo sua presa. o ML consegue a resgatar porque ela avisa todos os passos que dá a ele quase sempre. Ai é uma mescla entre romance, ele tentando confessar seus sentimentos por ela, ela pensando também se ele tem ou não sentimentos porque ela gosta dele também enquanto a investigação acontece, seja por parte da polícia quanto por parte do jornal que ela trabalha.Eu gostei bastante porque:1. Não tem CEO, herdeiro e identidade falsa. São pessoas mais próximas da nossa realidade.2. Não tem ex mala e chá-verde - a pseudo que aparece, na verdade só aparece em 2 cenas porque o ML a salvou na explosão.3. Romance - o romance apesar de ser lento, é compreensível, porque ela sempre pensou que o ML cuidou dela nestes 4 anos pelo senso de responsabilidade, mas quando ela o questiona, ele não foge, ele fala que havia várias formas de se responsabilizar e cuidar dela, que não precisaria casar, mas que ele casou porque gosta dela.O que eu não gostei:1. Eu queria muito que ela tivesse exposto no jornal em que trabalha, no fim, todos os abusos que também sofreu do pai, como as queimaduras de cigarro. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Letdown by writing & Yang Shu Yu's acting I was intrigued by this title after seeing a review on subreddit CShortDramas a few days ago. I didn't read the review in order to avoid spoilers. Last night I decided to watch the drama on iQIYI and hhhhmmm it was so-so. Intriguing start but second act onwards was boring for me.What I liked:1. Acting - Liu Yu Hang was excellent as he got to play two distinct characters. It was fun to watch the contrasting personalities.2. Secret - I liked that both FL & ML knew about the twin switch by episode 11. I also liked that FL caught her boyfriend cheating on her in episode 20.3. Lu Jingran - Silly, spoilt brat. He provided the comic relief.4. Romance - There were good kisses & sweet and tender moments.5. Styling - FL wore beautiful clothes. I loved the yellow canary dress. Her very high heels were pretty too. I also liked the contrasting styles for the twins.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - Song Qing An was a sick bastard & FL's mother was an accomplice. ML's father was an abusive & controlling father. I also disliked the betrothed fiancee to ML - she was delusional.2. FL characterisation - I found her bland & at times infuriating. It was nice that writer gave her a career which she kept a secret from her family but she was backed up by secret investor (ML) so I don't think her success was attributed to her own capabilities. I disliked her for leaving ML without a proper discussion on their relationship. 3. Yang Shu Yu - Her dramatic acting was one-note. She should be in agony after finding out the truth about her father's death.4. Chemistry - No chemistry between Yang Shu Yu & Liu Yu Hang. reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.5 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Great acting in this drama about two men in love I had this drama in my watchlist since last year when I was fascinated with Huang Jing Zhou. Thank you to Jwells for finding new links. Watched it today and wow, this was a good watch.What I liked:1. Acting - Amazing performances by the cast led by Zheng Feng & Huang Jing Zhou. They were great in their individual roles and as a pair. Wonderful chemistry. I could sense the tension and longing between their characters.2. Dynamics - I'd say that there is love between them. Zhou Yi Li always affected by Shen Ji Xing's affections whether they were words or physical touches. ZYL and his gazes - always looking out for SJX.3. SJX characterisation - I liked that he wore his heart on his sleeve. His arc was well-developed though I disliked when he hit ZYL at the start of the drama.4. ZYL characterisation - He was the opposite of SJX. Gave off dark vibe & always concealed his feelings & thoughts related to SJX. 5. Supporting characters - I really liked Pei Ming for her care & thoughtfulness. She went above & beyond her duty as SJX's manager. I also liked Mu Si because he verbalise his thoughts and seemed to empathise with SJX.6. Styling - I loved the contrasting styles between SJX & ZYL. ZYL always wore black, avant garde outfits like he was camera ready at any time. SJX wore a few white & light coloured pieces.What I disliked:1. Antagonists - FL's adopted mother was a psycho- controlling & possessive. It's creepy that she wanted SJX to herself like he was her lover.2. Length - It was roughly 2 hours 42 minutes. I couldn't watch in one sitting - had to take breaks then re-watch.Favourite sceneWhen SJX told ZYL what really happened that day 2 years ago Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 9.5 Story 9.5 Acting/Cast 10 Music 9.5 Rewatch Value 10 This review may contain spoilers What a beautiful love story Let me tell you, I came RUNNING asap when I was done watching this. I was completely fine understanding the plot and translations. Some subtitles sometimes don't get translated, which is frequent with machine translated, but even without that, it was SO GOOD. It should've been 30 full 1 hour episodes since this is a beautiful love story.The intro? Is rough but worry not, that is FAR from how the ML really is. The system of the novel wants to put him and the SFL together but thanks to the ML, he has spent 100,000 lives to finally get one last chance. That intro? Is the system controlling him. Make sure to not skip any scenes since they're important to the plot. All of the actors did phenomenal with this work. The story is so damn good I wish it was longer. I wish more would put a different spin on execution of rebirth + system + roles going against the novel since it can go any direction. And this? Honestly, a masterclass and one of the best with those tropes tied into a lovely feast. The writers did amazing, despite what the other reviewer's experience.Rewatchable? 100/10. This is so damn good. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Bali
reviews.review_text: Overall 7.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 This review may contain spoilers Ta Wen Xiao Mei Gui(2025), aka: Kiss With A Rose(2025), is a nice fantasy rebirth miniseries with Yang Yu Bin (as Jiang Sheng) and Fang Si Chang (as Ning Qiu Tang) in the leading’s couple role. The cast did well taking in consideration that the story is a bit complicated since the setting is related to the transmigration of real life characters into a story controlled by a “system” and the leading lady of the story. This novel should have been adapted into a longer running series since it has too many characters that are of importance to the system and needed to be explained better. The romance is underrated by the lack of time to be developed in a more intelligible way but it is a very interesting story to put on screen. The leading couple had a good rapport but the male lead still lacks the right facial expressions to bring about his intricate character. Overall, the drama has an interesting story and, for the most part, entertaining.Adapted from the web novel "Ta Wen Xiao Mei Gui" by Yi Yi San SanIn the meantime, this drama can be found in YouTube under the caption: “She died for love, reborn, she turned cold, only to be loved and protected by the man above all.” (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FRz1oMrNzqY) or “Once a pampered heiress, she was scorned and abused—all for loving the wrong man and one mistake.” (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=px6h4334h2k) Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 4.0 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 4.0 This review may contain spoilers CONFUSO! MEU DEUS DO CÉU, que nó na cabeça esse drama! EU TO MUITO CONFUSA! Eu não sei o que os roteiristas fumaram antes de escrever esse drama, mas eu definitivamente não fumei para assistir LOLNo começo parece que ela renasceu, depois aparece a 2FL que teoricamente é a heroína e tem um sistema que a ajuda na trama, ai do nada o ML é consciente e não explicam se era renascido ou ele era um personagem (depois explica). Fica 1 hora e pouco no vai-e-vem sem fim de ML, FL, 2FL até eles irem para um templo budista e receberem uma corda que o protege.Anh (1), ele ainda queima a cabana, porque aparentemente ele foi para um sanatório porque era consciente no role da história e dá uma facada no peito, mas ai no hospital, o pai/vô (já nem lembro mais, sendo que até pausei o drama para iniciar a resenha porque o negócio é tão doido que achei que esqueceria tudo), falar que ele apenas desmaiou e a cabana não foi queimada, mas ele tem a faixa no peito da facada (!!!!!), e no sonho ele descobre finalmente o rosto da pessoa que ele via tocando piano (!!!!!)Anhhh (2), e ainda do nada aparece uma menina cega que aparentemente estava no sanatório na mesma época e foi salva pelo ML e ela e um outro personagem são namorados (????) e ela simplesmente vai pra pista de corrida que a 2FL forçou esse cara a competir contra o ML kkkkkk Para então a 2FL simplesmente ser expulsa do enredo porque não conseguia mais forçar a trama do ML para se apaixonar por ela kkkkkkRespira... que tem mais... Então a FL e o ML se unem contra o sistema, porque aparentemente eles já renasceram 100.000 (legenda automática, lembre-se disso rs) e decidem ir no psicólogo (!!!!) e voilá... o psicólogo que os atendia era o autor (????? pelo menos foi o que a legenda automática disse), mas do nada, este mesmo psicólogo está com o monge, que sabe de tudo... kkkkkkkkkEntre tudo isso o ML desmaiou e invés de ir pro hospital, foi pro templo pra falar com o monge, mas chegando lá eles não falam nada direito com o cara e só entre a FL e o ML e aparentemente é a última chance que eles tem... Ai tem a cega, a cega virou muda porque foi punida pelo sistema/mentor, mas ao comer a bola da corda q caiu volta a enxergar e falar, mas antes disso tenta matar a FL, mas só corta a mão, mas ela "desaparece", é ameaçada pelo sistema, ela o apunhala e voilá, está desmaiada no hospital kkkkkk Depois nem lembro mais, só sei que o sistema ameaça de novo a FL e ela tem a brilhante ideia de engravidar do ML pra derrotar o sistema LOL e qdo finalmente chega a formatura, porque sim, eles ainda estavam na faculdade e resolvendo todos esses B.Os, a amiga da FL é possuída pelo sistema, que é de novo apunhalado e voilá, eles se casam kkkkkk EU NÃO SEI NEM QUE NOTA DAR PRA ISSO kkkkkk não sei se é bom, porque é muita loucura ou muito ruim porque me deu um nó no cérebro! synopsis: After transmigrating into a novel, Su Ting Tang goes wild, doing everything she can to provoke the tyrant into killing her — just so she can die and return to the modern world with one hundred million. Yet the tyrant only grips her waist with a low chuckle, “My beloved consort wants to escape?” It isn’t until Su Ting Tang discovers that the tyrant has lived through three rebirths, all to rewrite her tragic fate, that she finally understands. With reddened eyes, the tyrant kisses her and says, “I’ll trade my life… for your rebirth.” (Source: Chinese = Douban || Translation = MyDramaList) English Русский Español Português (Brasil)

reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 3.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Comedy turn forced sentimental. I watch this when i want to see more Li Li Zai works and this works is....mess.FL transmigrates into a book. The system's mission is that if the male protagonist kills him, she can return to the modern world. The female protagonist begins to seduce the male protagonist to make him want to killed her. But everything she wished is backward. ML always dotting on FL. Plot gets a bit out of control. FL accidentally discovers that the empress dowager plays mahjong, and that the MLt's secret chamber contains a television, a phonograph presented as tribute from a foreign land, bubble drink. And the plot twist just giving meh effect.The beginning is purely comedic, while the later parts are more sentimental but ML lacks of longing feeling is not making this drama better. Li Li Zai shows her lack of acting skill especially for sad scene make it painful to watch.Perhaps Li Li Zai fans could enjoy this drama. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 5.5 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 6.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 5.0 This review may contain spoilers Beautiful scenery hides hollow part of this plot. The combination of real scenery (Gobi Desert) and decent styling was contradicting with actual drama story.The plot is hollow and overly unrealistic, with numerous illogical details. ML is initially extremely cautious, even investigating FL's background, showing a "better safe than sorry" attitude. Is it even plausible that he would stoop to a fake marriage with a female celebrity if you are secret agent? The pacing was slow and the ex-girlfriend's storyline was completely unnecessary, purely an artificial obstacle for the main couple. Another problem is that Bai Fangwen and Guo Yuxin don't really have any chemistry; it's like they're each acting their own thing.Perhaps hardcore fans of both actors could enjoy this. reviews.author: emberzmars
reviews.review_text: Overall 6.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 2.0 This review may contain spoilers High production value & good acting but ML frustrated me Gosh I have been waiting for this drama since August and it finally released yesterday. It has been awhile since I last saw Jiao Pei Kai / Bai Fang Wen. I watched it last night before bed then continued the next morning. I literally just finished this drama and have mixed feelings.What I liked:1. Production value - Beautifully shot outdoor scenes at the Gobi Desert. Amazing landscape of the lesser seen China. This drama has pushed the envelope for the vertical drama industry.2. Acting - Wonderful performances by Guo Yu Xin and Bai Fang Wen. I could see and feel the pain experienced by their characters.3. Paper cutting scene - What a humbling scene! FL indirectly helped a girl to get back to school.4. Crime arc - i enjoyed this arc even though the focus was inconsistent. 5. Styling - I liked the outfits worn by both leads. BFW looked rugged as a park ranger.6. Supporting character - I liked ML's trusted colleague and the female doctor.What I disliked:1. ML's action - I got it that he was emotionally unavailable because of his personal demons. But why did he lie to FL about having a girlfriend while being married with her? Even though the "gf" caused a scene, I think FL's anger and disappointment were valid.2. Romance - I was dismayed that their romance was very much "push" dynamics because of ML's stubbornness. Only when FL was in danger did he show vulnerability but even then he was not fully honest. This drama could have been a healing of two souls with both helping each other but unfortunately not.3. Duration - 3 hours 18 minutes is the total screentime for this drama and I felt it was too long because the two arcs (romance & crime) were unfocused and not written well.4. Ending - There were several flashbacks in the final 20 minutes. I felt it was unnecessary because the storytelling was drawn out that I remembered what happened from the start. I wish the drama ended with them together on a healing journey (action oriented rather than a promise).Favourite sceneWhen ML tended to FL's injury Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: bugsrubby
reviews.review_text: Overall 10 Story 10 Acting/Cast 10 Music 10 Rewatch Value 10 Male Lead caught my attention! All Things Grow (2025) is a beautiful and emotional short drama that captures how love and growth can happen quietly but deeply. Even though each episode is short, the storytelling feels complete — every look, every silence, and every moment between the leads carries meaning.The chemistry between the main characters is strong and natural. Their emotions come through without overacting, and I liked how the story focuses not just on romance, but on healing, trust, and becoming better people for each other. The pacing is steady and the visuals are simple but warm, giving the whole drama a comforting tone.What touched me most was how realistic the characters feel — imperfect yet sincere. It’s not the typical overdramatic short drama, but something more grounded and heartfelt. A gentle reminder that love isn’t about perfection, but growth. Truly one of the better short dramas I’ve seen lately. 🌿💛love guo yu xinlove ML too! haven't watched him for a long time Read More Was this review helpful to you?

Pack My Bags, I'm Moving to China I’m not gonna lie, I actually enjoyed it. FL is a total badass, smart as hell too. She made money, reputation, friends and speedran her way into getting the rich family's golden grandson.And even after stacking all that W, she still chose to stand on her own two feet? I think so, 'cause the ending felt kinda chopped, maybe the link I watched was cut short or something. Either way, it was worth it.Yeah, the plot’s mad predictable and cliché, but FL’s visuals and mindset? Absolute chef’s kiss. She doesn’t hesitate to slap anyone who dares block her path. Love that energy.As for the ML, he's just there. Like a fancy little chihuahua, looks good, acts rich (barely), but doesn’t really do much else. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 5.5 Story 6.5 Acting/Cast 7.0 Music 4.0 Rewatch Value 4.0 This review may contain spoilers Poderia ser, mas nem sempre foi... O drama tinha muito potencial de ser muito bom, a FL, renascida de outra era, domina todas as pessoas mal intencionadas, possui uma beleza que demonstra ingenuidade/pureza e delicadeza, mas ela articula maravilhosamente bem para obter benefício próprio e tem uma postura fria perante a todos, pois em outra era teve que deixar suas ambições de vida de lado porque a mulher não podia ter a saga de vencer profissionalmente.Enquanto isso, o ML a observa e se fascina por essa dualidade, e sempre está por perto, mas a deixa agir livremente até o momento em que realmente está indefesa ou prestes a se ferir. Todos os links já lançados, seja no Youtube quanto no Telegram, o final é o mesmo, abrupto, após o pedido de casamento do ML, onde a FL lembra de sua vida na dinastia e tudo que almeja fazer, e o drama se encerra com ela retirando a mão antes dele inserir o anel. Porém, o que ela não percebeu é que ele sempre a deixou ser livre e celebrava suas conquistas, por menores que fossem e nunca a forçou como em alguns outros dramas vemos o ML interferindo em algumas dessas questões.Eu gostaria de que o pensamento dela não fosse apenas pensamento (as falas mentais) e sim que ela externasse para o ML tudo que estava sentindo e desejando, para então encerrar o drama com a reação dele, porque ali então conseguiríamos imaginar melhor o caminho que eles seguiriam.Por isso da minha nota... reviews.review_text: Overall 5.0 Story 5.0 Acting/Cast 5.0 Music 3.0 Rewatch Value 1.0 A Midway Drop Due to Lack of Interest This review is based on episodes 1-44 (roughly half the series).I have such a soft spot for Wu Tianhao. I tend to give his dramas a chance, especially when he’s in a lead role, since much of his work has been in supporting or guest appearances. I’ve watched him in My Lady General, Only Love You, Supervisor Husband, Secrets of the Shadow Sect, The Legend of Shen Li, Hard to Find, Lovesickness, and The Princess Royal—though, to be honest, I don’t remember his role in the last one. Unfortunately, I decided to let this one go for no other reason than the fact that the storyline just didn’t excite me. With so many dramas already on my watchlist, I have to be mindful of how I spend my time—I can’t watch dramas all day, every day.This is a vertical drama that follows the short-content formula, so it feels a bit choppy, and the narrative isn’t especially complex or highly produced. The storyline is a familiar palace revenge and power struggle, presented in the usual microdrama fashion—very soap opera–like. The script isn’t new, and if you’ve watched enough vertical or microdramas, the characters and tropes will feel instantly recognizable. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 5.5 Story 7.0 Acting/Cast 7.5 Music 5.5 Rewatch Value 7.5 This review may contain spoilers Another healthy duanju story I watched this last year because of Wang Ziyi attire in this drama and Wang Yanfei acting is exceptionally good, the two have amazing chemistry. This is a very short and sweet romance drama. FL, is a great character—smart, doesn't fight back, has a sharp tongue that never backs down, and is also strong in combat. She's sunny, cheerful, and quick to learn; her grandmother raised her very well. ML is brave, resourceful, and incredibly romantic, with a strong sense of boundaries! No shielding, no drugging, no "white moonlight" (idealized love interest). ML's sole focus is on the FL. They firmly believe in each other, team up to avenge her, and everyone helps them achieve a happy ending. The cons of this drama there is no conflict and the supporting actors except child actor were mediocre and quite not memorable for me. I rewatched for reminiscing the drama and the highlight was Wang Yanfei acting. Still recommended if you like healthy story without conflict. Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 7.5 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Tian Jiu Luo embrace real Yun Qi. Finally there is MDL page about this drama since i want to make an ode to this drama even i wont give them 9.5 but i need to write this.Yun Qi 's unparalleled beauty needs to be portrayed like this. Tian Jiu Luo perfectly captured the Princess's alluring, desireful, ruthless, scheming, cute, and aggrieved sides, showcasing her exceptional acting skills and she is sole winner based from the characterization. Too bad she stills underrated actress in duanju.Ming Chuan as FL ex-husband was still being likeable unlike other version. This version makes the ex-husband, the general, a bit more shy.This version has kisses with several fish, finally showing the proper way to handle a 1vN dynamic! Did the screenwriters and directors see this? This is the correct way to handle multiple male leads! I love the scene where the Eldest Princess kisses her younger brother and then slaps him.The cons in this drama beside abrupt ending is filters and skin smoothing are way too heavy.I hope there is season 2 of this version since i love this Yun Qi version. reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 8.0 Acting/Cast 8.0 Music 8.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 A good mix of reverse harem, fantasy, romance & revenge! Judging by the rather low overall rating (7.4) at the time I started watching this drama and the fact that fantasy isn't really my favorite genre, I didn't expect much but after watching the first 2 episodes, I find it quite fun to watch!the acting is good, and on top of that the cast are all so good looking!the bickering of Ao Jue and Chong ming is fun to watch and the chemistry is good! (I don't mean it just as romantic but as a trio of 3 strong different characters that get along well despite the arguments) the three of them make such a great team!!I think it could count as a reverse harem drama in the first half but in second half it turns into the typical romance drama match up of couples. The scenes are entertaining, and somewhat over the top but it's neither cringe nor awkward.I like that the drama doesn't beat around the bush that much and gets straight to the point. (for example the introduction of the characters were done the way it wasn't difficult to figure the relationships).though it did drag a bit in the last 6 episodes.they all desire something and are willing to do what it takes to get it.The cgi is okay.The ost was nice. the few complaints that I can come up with are as follows;-the dubbing sometimes feels off (a bit out of sync) but I could overlook it since it wasn't to the point of distracting me.-some episodes starts in new plot points that didn't have any build up from previous episode's ending.-the mask man's identity was easy to guess! I said it was too easy because I'm not the type to analyze stuff while watching dramas and I usually let the drama surprise me with a reveal. (by ep 5 it's hard not to know and that's a bit too early for a 24 episode drama) -I'm nitpicking on this one! Although they did a good job for casting of the sister, the casting for fl's teen years left me speechless. It's one of the good short cdramas and you might have to stretch the logic for some parts but it's not as severe to the point of making it silly.The ending was done well and didn't disappoint. I think it was worth a watch. Read More Was this review helpful to you?
